en_text: Abu Ma'n al-Raqashi, Abu Bakr ibn Nafi', and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me, they said: Abu 'Amir—who is 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Amr—narrated to us, Aflah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, 'Abdullah ibn Rafi' narrated to us, he said: Umm Salamah used to narrate that she heard the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying upon the pulpit while her hair was being combed: "O people!" So she said to the woman combing her hair: "Leave my head." ...similar to the hadith of Bukayr from al-Qasim ibn 'Abbas.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2296 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ يَوْمًا فَصَلَّى عَلَى أَهْلِ أُحُدٍ صَلاَتَهُ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي فَرَطٌ لَكُمْ وَأَنَا شَهِيدٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لأَنْظُرُ إِلَى حَوْضِيَ الآنَ وَإِنِّي قَدْ أُعْطِيتُ مَفَاتِيحَ خَزَائِنِ الأَرْضِ أَوْ مَفَاتِيحَ الأَرْضِ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُشْرِكُوا بَعْدِي وَلَكِنْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَتَنَافَسُوا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, Layth narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu al-Khayr, from 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) went out one day and prayed over the people of Uhud as he prayed over the deceased, then turned toward the pulpit and said: "Indeed, I am your forerunner, and I am a witness over you. By Allah, I am indeed looking at my Basin right now, and indeed I have been given the keys of the treasures of the earth—or the keys of the earth. And by Allah, I do not fear for you that you will associate partners with Allah after me, but I fear for you that you will compete with one another for it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2296 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَرِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ أَيُّوبَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَتْلَى أُحُدٍ ثُمَّ صَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ كَالْمُوَدِّعِ لِلأَحْيَاءِ وَالأَمْوَاتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي فَرَطُكُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ وَإِنَّ عَرْضَهُ كَمَا بَيْنَ أَيْلَةَ إِلَى الْجُحْفَةِ إِنِّي لَسْتُ أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُشْرِكُوا بَعْدِي وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمُ الدُّنْيَا أَنْ تَنَافَسُوا فِيهَا وَتَقْتَتِلُوا فَتَهْلِكُوا كَمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُقْبَةُ فَكَانَتْ آخِرَ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, Wahb—meaning Ibn Jarir—narrated to us, my father narrated to us, he said: I heard Yahya ibn Ayyub narrating from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Marthad, from 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) prayed over the slain of Uhud, then ascended the pulpit like one bidding farewell to the living and the dead, and said: "Indeed, I am your forerunner at the Basin, and its width is like the distance between Aylah and al-Juhfah. Indeed, I do not fear that you will associate partners with Allah after me, but I fear for you the worldly life: that you will vie with one another for it, and fight one another, and perish as those before you perished." 'Uqbah said: That was the last time I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) upon the pulpit.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2297 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَا فَرَطُكُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ وَلأُنَازِعَنَّ أَقْوَامًا ثُمَّ لأُغْلَبَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Abu Kurayb, and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, they said: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq, from 'Abdullah, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "I am your forerunner at the Basin, and people will certainly be contended with me over, and then I will be overcome regarding them. I will say: O Lord, my companions, my companions! But it will be said: Indeed, you do not know what innovations they introduced after you."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2297 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us, from Jarir, from al-A'mash, with this chain of transmission, and he did not mention: "my companions, my companions."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2297 c, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ الأَعْمَشِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, both from Jarir; (H) and Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, all of them from Mughirah, from Abu Wa'il, from 'Abdullah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), similar to the hadith of al-A'mash. And in the hadith of Shu'bah from Mughirah: "I heard Abu Wa'il."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2297 d, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الأَعْمَشِ وَمُغِيرَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: And Sa'id ibn 'Amr al-Ash'athi narrated it to us, 'Abthar informed us; (H) and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Ibn Fudayl narrated to us, both from Husayn, from Abu Wa'il, from Hudhayfah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), similar to the hadith of al-A'mash and Mughirah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2298 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ، بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ حَارِثَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ حَوْضُهُ مَا بَيْنَ صَنْعَاءَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمُسْتَوْرِدُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الأَوَانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْمُسْتَوْرِدُ ‏"‏ تُرَى فِيهِ الآنِيَةُ مِثْلَ الْكَوَاكِبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Bazi' narrated to me, Ibn Abi 'Adi narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Ma'bad ibn Khalid, from Harithah, that he heard the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: "His Basin is what is between Sanaa and Medina." Al-Mustawrid said to him: "Did you not hear him mention the vessels?" He said: "No." Al-Mustawrid said: "In it, the vessels are seen like planets."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2298 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ الْحَوْضَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ وَقَوْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn 'Ar'arah narrated to me, Harami ibn 'Umarah narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from Ma'bad ibn Khalid, that he heard Harithah ibn Wahb al-Khuza'i saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying... and he mentioned the Basin the like of it, and did not mention the statement of al-Mustawrid nor his response.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2299 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَمَامَكُمْ حَوْضًا مَا بَيْنَ نَاحِيَتَيْهِ كَمَا بَيْنَ جَرْبَا وَأَذْرُحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Rabi' al-Zahrani and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us, they said: Hammad—who is Ibn Zayd—narrated to us, Ayyub narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, ahead of you is a Basin; what is between its two sides is like that between Jarba and Adhruh."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2299 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَمَامَكُمْ حَوْضًا كَمَا بَيْنَ جَرْبَا وَأَذْرُحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ الْمُثَنَّى ‏"‏ حَوْضِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and 'Ubaydullah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, they said: Yahya—who is al-Qattan—narrated to us, from 'Ubaydullah: Nafi' informed me, from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), he said: "Indeed, ahead of you is a Basin whose extent is like that between Jarba and Adhruh." And in the narration of Ibn al-Muthanna: "my Basin."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2299 c, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، بِشْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ قَرْيَتَيْنِ بِالشَّامِ بَيْنَهُمَا مَسِيرَةُ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ بِشْرٍ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Numayr narrated to us, my father narrated to us; (H) and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, they said: 'Ubaydullah narrated to us, with this chain of transmission, the like of it, and he added: 'Ubaydullah said: So I asked him, and he said: "Two villages in the Levant, between which is a journey of three nights." And in the hadith of Ibn Bishr: "three days."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2299 d, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Suwayd ibn Sa'id narrated to me, Hafs ibn Maysarah narrated to us, from Musa ibn 'Uqbah, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of the hadith of 'Ubaydullah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2299 e, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَمَامَكُمْ حَوْضًا كَمَا بَيْنَ جَرْبَا وَأَذْرُحَ فِيهِ أَبَارِيقُ كَنُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ مَنْ وَرَدَهُ فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ لَمْ يَظْمَأْ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me, 'Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us, 'Umar ibn Muhammad narrated to me, from Nafi', from 'Abdullah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, ahead of you is a Basin whose extent is like that between Jarba and Adhruh. In it are jugs like the stars of heaven; whoever arrives at it and drinks from it will never thirst after it, ever."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2300, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ، الصَّمَدِ الْعَمِّيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا آنِيَةُ الْحَوْضِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لآنِيَتُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ عَدَدِ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ وَكَوَاكِبِهَا أَلاَ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْمُظْلِمَةِ الْمُصْحِيَةِ آنِيَةُ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهَا لَمْ يَظْمَأْ آخِرَ مَا عَلَيْهِ يَشْخُبُ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ لَمْ يَظْمَأْ عَرْضُهُ مِثْلُ طُولِهِ مَا بَيْنَ عَمَّانَ إِلَى أَيْلَةَ مَاؤُهُ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, and Ibn Abi 'Umar al-Makki narrated to us—and the wording is Ibn Abi Shaybah's; Ishaq said: informed us, and the other two said: narrated to us—'Abd al-'Aziz ibn 'Abd al-Samad al-'Ammi, from Abu 'Imran al-Jawni, from 'Abdullah ibn al-Samit, from Abu Dharr, he said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the vessels of the Basin?" He said: "By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, its vessels are more numerous than the number of stars and planets of heaven on a dark, cloudless night. They are vessels of Paradise: whoever drinks from them will never thirst to the end of his existence. Two spouts from Paradise pour into it; whoever drinks from it will never thirst. Its width is like its length, from 'Amman to Aylah; its water is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2301 a, b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْيَعْمَرِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَبِعُقْرِ حَوْضِي أَذُودُ النَّاسَ لأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ أَضْرِبُ بِعَصَاىَ حَتَّى يَرْفَضَّ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسُئِلَ عَنْ عَرْضِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ مَقَامِي إِلَى عَمَّانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسُئِلَ عَنْ شَرَابِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ اللَّبَنِ وَأَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ يَغُتُّ فِيهِ مِيزَابَانِ يَمُدَّانِهِ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ أَحَدُهُمَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَالآخَرُ مِنْ وَرِقٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِإِسْنَادِ هِشَامٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ عُقْرِ الْحَوْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us—and their wordings are close—they said: Mu'adh—who is Ibn Hisham—narrated to us, my father narrated to me, from Qatadah, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah al-Ya'mari, from Thawban, that the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, I will be at the edge of my Basin, driving away the people for the people of Yemen, striking with my staff until it flows abundantly for them." He was asked about its width, so he said: "From my standing place to 'Amman." And he was asked about its drink, so he said: "Whiter than milk and sweeter than honey; two spouts flow into it supplying it from Paradise, one of gold and the other of silver." And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me, al-Hasan ibn Musa narrated to us, Shayban narrated to us, from Qatadah, with the chain of transmission of Hisham, similar to his hadith, except that he said: "On the Day of Resurrection, I will be at the edge of the Basin."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2301 c, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ، بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ مَعْدَانَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثَ الْحَوْضِ فَقُلْتُ لِيَحْيَى بْنِ حَمَّادٍ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ فَقَالَ وَسَمِعْتُهُ أَيْضًا مِنْ شُعْبَةَ فَقُلْتُ انْظُرْ لِي فِيهِ فَنَظَرَ لِي فِيهِ فَحَدَّثَنِي بِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Yahya ibn Hammad narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Ma'dan, from Thawban, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the hadith of the Basin. I said to Yahya ibn Hammad: "Did you hear this hadith from Abu 'Awanah?" He said: "And I also heard it from Shu'bah." I said: "Look into it for me," so he looked into it for me and narrated it to me.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2302 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لأَذُودَنَّ عَنْ حَوْضِي رِجَالاً كَمَا تُذَادُ الْغَرِيبَةُ مِنَ الإِبِلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Sallam al-Jumahi narrated to us, al-Rabi'—meaning Ibn Muslim—narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "I will surely drive away men from my Basin just as stray camels are driven away."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2302 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: And 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated it to me, my father narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad: he heard Abu Hurayrah saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2303 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْرُ حَوْضِي كَمَا بَيْنَ أَيْلَةَ وَصَنْعَاءَ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ وَإِنَّ فِيهِ مِنَ الأَبَارِيقِ كَعَدَدِ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me, Ibn Wahb informed us, Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, that Anas ibn Malik narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "The extent of my Basin is like that between Aylah and Sanaa of Yemen, and indeed in it are jugs as numerous as the stars of heaven."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2303 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، وَهُرَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَاصِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ نَاحِيَتَىْ حَوْضِي كَمَا بَيْنَ صَنْعَاءَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Asim ibn al-Nadr al-Taymi and Huraym ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us—and the wording is 'Asim's—Mu'tamir narrated to us: I heard my father; Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), he said: "The distance between the two sides of my Basin is like that between Sanaa and Medina."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2303 c, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ، بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُمَا شَكَّا فَقَالاَ أَوْ مِثْلَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَدِينَةِ وَعَمَّانَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَىْ حَوْضِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us, 'Abd al-Samad narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us; (H) and Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Hulwani narrated to us, Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi narrated to us, Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, both from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) the like of it, except that both of them were in doubt and said: "or like what is between Medina and 'Amman." And in the hadith of Abu 'Awanah: "between the two borders of my Basin."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2303 d, e, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرُّزِّيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ، بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تُرَى فِيهِ أَبَارِيقُ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ كَعَدَدِ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ عَدَدِ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi and Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah al-Ruzzi narrated to me, they said: Khalid ibn al-Harith narrated to us, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, he said: Anas said: The Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "In it are seen jugs of gold and silver like the number of the stars of heaven." And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me, al-Hasan ibn Musa narrated to us, Shayban narrated to us, from Qatadah: Anas ibn Malik narrated to us that the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said the like of it, and added: "or more than the number of the stars of heaven."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2304 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الصَّفَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الْعَزِيزِ بْنَ صُهَيْبٍ، يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيَرِدَنَّ عَلَىَّ الْحَوْضَ رِجَالٌ مِمَّنْ صَاحَبَنِي حَتَّى إِذَا رَأَيْتُهُمْ وَرُفِعُوا إِلَىَّ اخْتُلِجُوا دُونِي فَلأَقُولَنَّ أَىْ رَبِّ أُصَيْحَابِي أُصَيْحَابِي ‏.‏ فَلَيُقَالَنَّ لِي إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me, 'Affan ibn Muslim al-Saffar narrated to us, Wuhayb narrated to us, he said: I heard 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Suhayb narrating, he said: Anas ibn Malik narrated to us that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Men from among those who accompanied me will surely come to me at the Basin, until when I see them and they are brought up to me, they will be snatched away from me. I will surely say: O Lord, my companions, my companions! But it will surely be said to me: Indeed, you do not know what innovations they introduced after you."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2304 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْمَعْنَى وَزَادَ ‏"‏ آنِيَتُهُ عَدَدُ النُّجُومِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and 'Ali ibn Hujr narrated to us, they said: 'Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us; (H) and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Ibn Fudayl narrated to us, all of them from al-Mukhtar ibn Fulful, from Anas, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) with this meaning, and he added: "its vessels are the number of the stars."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2305 a, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ السَّكُونِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، - رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ - حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ إِنِّي فَرَطٌ لَكُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ وَإِنَّ بُعْدَ مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ كَمَا بَيْنَ صَنْعَاءَ وَأَيْلَةَ كَأَنَّ الأَبَارِيقَ فِيهِ النُّجُومُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ibn al-Walid al-Sakuni narrated to me, my father—may Allah have mercy on him—narrated to me, Ziyad ibn Khaythamah narrated to me, from Simak ibn Harb, from Jabir ibn Samurah, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), he said: "Behold! Indeed, I am your forerunner at the Basin, and indeed the distance between its two edges is like the distance between Sanaa and Aylah, with its jugs appearing like the stars."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2305 b, book 43, باب إِثْبَاتِ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصِفَاتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ كَتَبْتُ إِلَى جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ مَعَ غُلاَمِي نَافِعٍ أَخْبِرْنِي بِشَىْءٍ، سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَكَتَبَ إِلَىَّ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنَا الْفَرَطُ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, they said: Hatim ibn Isma'il narrated to us, from al-Muhajir ibn Mismar, from 'Amir ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, he said: I wrote to Jabir ibn Samurah via my servant Nafi': "Inform me of something you heard from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)." He said: So he wrote back to me: "I heard him saying: I am your forerunner at the Basin."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2306 a, book 43, باب فِي قِتَالِ جِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عَنْ يَمِينِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ثِيَابُ بَيَاضٍ مَا رَأَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي جِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bishr and Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Mis'ar, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Sa'd, he said: On the day of Uhud, I saw on the right of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and on his left two men wearing white garments whom I had never seen before nor after—meaning Jibril and Mika'il (peace be upon them both).

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2306 b, book 43, باب فِي قِتَالِ جِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، بْنُ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ عَنْ يَمِينِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ثِيَابٌ بِيضٌ يُقَاتِلاَنِ عَنْهُ كَأَشَدِّ الْقِتَالِ مَا رَأَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me, 'Abd al-Samad ibn 'Abd al-Warith informed us, Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us, Sa'd narrated to us, from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, he said: On the day of Uhud, I saw on the right of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and on his left two men wearing white garments fighting fiercely on his behalf; I had never seen them before nor after.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2307 a, book 43, باب فِي شَجَاعَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقَدُّمِهِ لِلْحَرْبِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا - حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ وَكَانَ أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ وَكَانَ أَشْجَعَ النَّاسِ وَلَقَدْ فَزِعَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَانْطَلَقَ نَاسٌ قِبَلَ الصَّوْتِ فَتَلَقَّاهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَاجِعًا وَقَدْ سَبَقَهُمْ إِلَى الصَّوْتِ وَهُوَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ عُرْىٍ فِي عُنُقِهِ السَّيْفُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَمْ تُرَاعُوا لَمْ تُرَاعُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَدْنَاهُ بَحْرًا أَوْ إِنَّهُ لَبَحْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ فَرَسًا يُبَطَّأُ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Sa'id ibn Mansur, Abu al-Rabi' al-'Ataki, and Abu Kamil narrated to us—and the wording is Yahya's; Yahya said: informed us, and the others said: narrated to us—Hammad ibn Zayd, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was the best of people, the most generous of people, and the bravest of people. One night the people of Medina were alarmed, so some people went out toward the sound. They were met by the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) returning, having already preceded them to the sound. He was riding a bareback horse belonging to Abu Talhah with a sword hung around his neck, saying: "Do not be alarmed, do not be alarmed!" He said: "We found it as swift as a sea," or "Indeed, it is a sea." He said: And it was a horse that used to be considered slow.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2307 b, book 43, باب فِي شَجَاعَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقَدُّمِهِ لِلْحَرْبِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَزَعٌ فَاسْتَعَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَسًا لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَنْدُوبٌ فَرَكِبَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا رَأَيْنَا مِنْ فَزَعٍ وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَاهُ لَبَحْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Waki' narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas, he said: There was an alarm in Medina, so the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) borrowed a horse belonging to Abu Talhah called Mandub and rode it. He then said: "We saw no cause for alarm, and indeed we found it as swift as a sea."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2307 c, book 43, باب فِي شَجَاعَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَقَدُّمِهِ لِلْحَرْبِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ فَرَسًا لَنَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated it to us, they said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us; (H) and Yahya ibn Habib narrated it to me, Khalid—meaning Ibn al-Harith—narrated to us, both said: Shu'bah narrated to us, with this chain of transmission. And in the hadith of Ibn Ja'far, he said: "a horse belonging to us," and did not say: "belonging to Abu Talhah." And in the hadith of Khalid from Qatadah: "I heard Anas."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2308 a, book 43, باب كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عِمْرَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ بِالْخَيْرِ وَكَانَ أَجْوَدَ مَا يَكُونُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَلْقَاهُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ حَتَّى يَنْسَلِخَ فَيَعْرِضُ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقُرْآنَ فَإِذَا لَقِيَهُ جِبْرِيلُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ ‏.‏
en_text: Mansur ibn Abi Muzahim narrated to us, Ibrahim—meaning Ibn Sa'd—narrated to us, from al-Zuhri; (H) and Abu 'Imran, Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Ziyad narrated to me—and the wording is his—Ibrahim informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abdullah ibn 'Utbah ibn Mas'ud, from Ibn 'Abbas, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was the most generous of people in doing good, and he was at his most generous during the month of Ramadan. Indeed, Jibril (peace be upon him) used to meet him every year in Ramadan until it drew to an end, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) would recite the Quran to him. When Jibril met him, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was more generous in giving good than the blowing wind.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2308 b, book 43, باب كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ بِالْخَيْرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرْسَلَةِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Kurayb narrated it to us, Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Yunus; (H) and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us, Ma'mar informed us, both from al-Zuhri, with this chain of transmission, similar to it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2309 a, book 43, باب كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ خَدَمْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشْرَ سِنِينَ وَاللَّهِ مَا قَالَ لِي أُفًّا ‏.‏ قَطُّ وَلاَ قَالَ لِي لِشَىْءٍ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا وَهَلاَّ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا زَادَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ لَيْسَ مِمَّا يَصْنَعُهُ الْخَادِمُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَهُ وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Sa'id ibn Mansur and Abu al-Rabi' narrated to us, they said: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: I served the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) for ten years. By Allah, he never said "Uff" to me at all, nor did he ever say to me regarding anything, "Why did you do such and such?" or "Why didn't you do such and such?" Abu al-Rabi' added: "regarding what a servant does," and did not mention his words: "By Allah."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2309 b, book 43, باب كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated it to us, Sallam ibn Miskin narrated to us, Thabit al-Bunani narrated to us, from Anas, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2309 c, book 43, باب كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَحْمَدَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ أَخَذَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ بِيَدِي فَانْطَلَقَ بِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَنَسًا غُلاَمٌ كَيِّسٌ فَلْيَخْدُمْكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَدَمْتُهُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْحَضَرِ وَاللَّهِ مَا قَالَ لِي لِشَىْءٍ صَنَعْتُهُ لِمَ صَنَعْتَ هَذَا هَكَذَا وَلاَ لِشَىْءٍ لَمْ أَصْنَعْهُ لِمَ لَمْ تَصْنَعْ هَذَا هَكَذَا
en_text: And Ahmad ibn Hanbal and Zuhayr ibn Harb both narrated it to us from Isma'il—and the wording is Ahmad's—they said: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, 'Abd al-'Aziz narrated to us, from Anas, he said: When the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) arrived in Medina, Abu Talhah took me by the hand and went with me to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), saying: "O Messenger of Allah, Anas is an intelligent boy, so let him serve you." He said: So I served him while traveling and while resident; by Allah, he never said to me regarding anything I did, "Why did you do this in such a way?" nor regarding anything I did not do, "Why did you not do this in such a way?"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2309 d, book 43, باب كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ - عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ خَدَمْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تِسْعَ سِنِينَ فَمَا أَعْلَمُهُ قَالَ لِي قَطُّ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا وَلاَ عَابَ عَلَىَّ شَيْئًا قَطُّ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, they said: Muhammad ibn Bishr narrated to us, Zakariyya narrated to us, Sa'id—who is Ibn Abi Burdah—narrated to me, from Anas, he said: I served the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) for nine years, and I never knew him to say to me at all, "Why did you do such and such?" nor did he ever criticize me for anything.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2310 a, 2309 e, book 43, باب كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، زَيْدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - قَالَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَحْسَنِ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا فَأَرْسَلَنِي يَوْمًا لِحَاجَةٍ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَذْهَبُ ‏.‏ وَفِي نَفْسِي أَنْ أَذْهَبَ لِمَا أَمَرَنِي بِهِ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجْتُ حَتَّى أَمُرَّ عَلَى صِبْيَانٍ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي السُّوقِ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ قَبَضَ بِقَفَاىَ مِنْ وَرَائِي - قَالَ - فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُنَيْسُ أَذَهَبْتَ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ أَنَا أَذْهَبُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ خَدَمْتُهُ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ مَا عَلِمْتُهُ قَالَ لِشَىْءٍ صَنَعْتُهُ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا أَوْ لِشَىْءٍ تَرَكْتُهُ هَلاَّ فَعَلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Ma'n al-Raqashi, Zayd ibn Yazid narrated to me, 'Umar ibn Yunus informed us, 'Ikrimah—who is Ibn 'Ammar—narrated to us, he said: Ishaq said: Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was of the best character among people. One day he sent me for an errand, so I said: "By Allah, I will not go," while in my heart I intended to go to do what the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) commanded me. So I went out until I passed by some boys playing in the marketplace. Suddenly the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) took hold of the nape of my neck from behind. He said: I looked at him and he was laughing, and he said: "O Unays, did you go where I ordered you?" I said: "Yes, I am going, O Messenger of Allah." Anas said: By Allah, I served him for nine years, and I never knew him to say regarding anything I did, "Why did you do such and such?" or regarding anything I left undone, "Why did you not do such and such?"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2310 b, book 43, باب كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا ‏.‏
en_text: Shayban ibn Farrukh and Abu al-Rabi' narrated to us, they said: 'Abd al-Warith narrated to us, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) had the finest character among all people.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2311 a, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, they said: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir: he heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah say: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was never asked for anything at all and said "No."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2311 b, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَشْجَعِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ يَقُولُ مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb narrated to us, al-Ashja'i narrated to us; (H) and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me, 'Abd al-Rahman—meaning Ibn Mahdi—narrated to us, both from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, he said: I heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah saying the exact same thing.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2312 a, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ - قَالَ - فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَأَعْطَاهُ غَنَمًا بَيْنَ جَبَلَيْنِ فَرَجَعَ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَسْلِمُوا فَإِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يُعْطِي عَطَاءً لاَ يَخْشَى الْفَاقَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Asim ibn al-Nadr al-Taymi narrated to us, Khalid—meaning Ibn al-Harith—narrated to us, Humayd narrated to us, from Musa ibn Anas, from his father, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was never asked for anything for the sake of Islam except that he gave it. He said: A man came to him, so he gave him sheep filling the valley between two mountains. The man returned to his people and said: "O my people, embrace Islam! For indeed Muhammad gives such a gift as one who fears no destitution."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2312 b, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَنَمًا بَيْنَ جَبَلَيْنِ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ فَأَتَى قَوْمَهُ فَقَالَ أَىْ قَوْمِ أَسْلِمُوا فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا لَيُعْطِي عَطَاءً مَا يَخَافُ الْفَقْرَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ إِنْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ لَيُسْلِمُ مَا يُرِيدُ إِلاَّ الدُّنْيَا فَمَا يُسْلِمُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ الإِسْلاَمُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas, that a man asked the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) for sheep filling the valley between two mountains, so he gave them to him. The man then returned to his people and said: "O my people, embrace Islam! For by Allah, Muhammad gives such a gift as if he fears no poverty." Anas said: A man might embrace Islam desiring nothing but worldly gain, but he would not stay Muslim long before Islam became dearer to him than the worldly life and all that is in it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2313, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ غَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ الْفَتْحِ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَاقْتَتَلُوا بِحُنَيْنٍ فَنَصَرَ اللَّهُ دِينَهُ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ مِائَةً مِنَ النَّعَمِ ثُمَّ مِائَةً ثُمَّ مِائَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ أَنَّ صَفْوَانَ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَعْطَانِي وَإِنَّهُ لأَبْغَضُ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ فَمَا بَرِحَ يُعْطِينِي حَتَّى إِنَّهُ لأَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir, Ahmad ibn 'Amr ibn Sarh narrated to me, 'Abdullah ibn Wahb informed us, Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) led the expedition of the Conquest—the Conquest of Mecca—then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) marched out with those of the Muslims who were with him, and they fought at Hunayn. Allah granted victory to His religion and the Muslims, and on that day the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) gave Safwan ibn Umayyah one hundred camels, then one hundred, then one hundred. Ibn Shihab said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab narrated to me that Safwan said: "By Allah, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) gave me what he gave me while he was the most hated of people to me, and he continued giving to me until he became the most beloved of people to me."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2314 a, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ، بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، وَعَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَحَدُهُمَا يَزِيدُ عَلَى الآخَرِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَسَمِعْتُ أَيْضًا، عَمْرَو بْنَ دِينَارٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَزَادَ، أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَى الآخَرِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ قَدْ جَاءَنَا مَالُ الْبَحْرَيْنِ لَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتُكَ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بِيَدَيْهِ جَمِيعًا فَقُبِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجِيءَ مَالُ الْبَحْرَيْنِ فَقَدِمَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ بَعْدَهُ فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِدَةٌ أَوْ دَيْنٌ فَلْيَأْتِ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ قَدْ جَاءَنَا مَالُ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَعْطَيْتُكَ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَثَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي عُدَّهَا ‏.‏ فَعَدَدْتُهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ خَمْسُمِائَةٍ فَقَالَ خُذْ مِثْلَيْهَا ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to us, Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir, that he heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah; (H) and Ishaq narrated to us, Sufyan informed us, from Ibn al-Munkadir from Jabir, and from 'Amr from Muhammad ibn 'Ali from Jabir, one of them adding to the other; (H) and Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us—and the wording is his—he said: Sufyan said: I heard Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir saying: I heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah; and Sufyan said: I also heard 'Amr ibn Dinar narrating from Muhammad ibn 'Ali, who said: I heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah, and one of them added to the other, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "If the wealth of Bahrain were to come to us, I would give you like this, like this, and like this"—gesturing with both of his hands. But the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) passed away before the wealth of Bahrain arrived. When it was brought to Abu Bakr afterwards, he ordered a caller who announced: "Whoever was promised something by the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) or was owed a debt, let him come." So I stood up and said: "Indeed, the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: If the wealth of Bahrain were to come to us, I would give you like this, like this, and like this." So Abu Bakr scooped up a handful once, and then said to me: "Count it." I counted it, and behold, it was five hundred. He said: "Take twice as much again."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2314 b, book 43, باب مَا سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏ وَكَثْرَةِ عَطَائِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا مَاتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ مَالٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَيْنٌ أَوْ كَانَتْ لَهُ قِبَلَهُ عِدَةٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us, Ibn Jurayj informed us: 'Amr ibn Dinar informed me, from Muhammad ibn 'Ali, from Jabir ibn 'Abdullah; and he said: Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir informed me, from Jabir ibn 'Abdullah, he said: When the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) died, wealth came to Abu Bakr from al-'Ala' ibn al-Hadrami, so Abu Bakr said: "Whoever was owed a debt by the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) or was given a promise by him, let him come to us"... similar to the hadith of Ibn 'Uyaynah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2315, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، وَشَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِشَيْبَانَ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وُلِدَ لِيَ اللَّيْلَةَ غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّيْتُهُ بِاسْمِ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَفَعَهُ إِلَى أُمِّ سَيْفٍ امْرَأَةِ قَيْنٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو سَيْفٍ فَانْطَلَقَ يَأْتِيهِ وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى أَبِي سَيْفٍ وَهُوَ يَنْفُخُ بِكِيرِهِ قَدِ امْتَلأَ الْبَيْتُ دُخَانًا فَأَسْرَعْتُ الْمَشْىَ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا سَيْفٍ أَمْسِكْ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَمْسَكَ فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالصَّبِيِّ فَضَمَّهُ إِلَيْهِ وَقَالَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ وَهُوَ يَكِيدُ بِنَفْسِهِ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَمَعَتْ عَيْنَا رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَدْمَعُ الْعَيْنُ وَيَحْزَنُ الْقَلْبُ وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا وَاللَّهِ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِنَّا بِكَ لَمَحْزُونُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Haddab ibn Khalid and Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us, both from Sulayman—and the wording is Shayban's—Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah narrated to us, Thabit al-Bunani narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "A boy was born to me tonight, and I have named him after the name of my forefather Ibrahim." Then he handed him over to Umm Sayf, the wife of a blacksmith named Abu Sayf. He set out to visit him, and I followed him. We reached Abu Sayf while he was blowing his bellows, and the house had filled with smoke. I quickened my pace ahead of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: "O Abu Sayf, hold on! The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) has arrived." So he stopped, and the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) called for the child, held him close to himself, and said whatever Allah willed him to say. Anas said: I later saw him breathing his last in the arms of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). The eyes of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) shed tears, and he said: "The eye weeps, and the heart grieves, but we do not say anything except what pleases our Lord; and by Allah, O Ibrahim, we are indeed sorrowful over your departure."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2316, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا كَانَ أَرْحَمَ بِالْعِيَالِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ مُسْتَرْضِعًا لَهُ فِي عَوَالِي الْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانَ يَنْطَلِقُ وَنَحْنُ مَعَهُ فَيَدْخُلُ الْبَيْتَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيُدَّخَنُ وَكَانَ ظِئْرُهُ قَيْنًا فَيَأْخُذُهُ فَيُقَبِّلُهُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ابْنِي وَإِنَّهُ مَاتَ فِي الثَّدْىِ وَإِنَّ لَهُ لَظِئْرَيْنِ تُكَمِّلاَنِ رَضَاعَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us—and the wording is Zuhayr's—they said: Isma'il—who is Ibn 'Ulayyah—narrated to us, from Ayyub, from 'Amr ibn Sa'id, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: I never saw anyone more merciful toward family and children than the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). He said: Ibrahim was being nursed in the upper suburbs of Medina; he would go there, accompanied by us, and enter the house—which was filled with smoke, as his foster-father was a blacksmith—and he would take him and kiss him, and then return. 'Amr said: When Ibrahim passed away, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, Ibrahim is my son, and he died while still suckling, and he has two wet nurses who will complete his suckling in Paradise."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2317, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَدِمَ نَاسٌ مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا أَتُقَبِّلُونَ صِبْيَانَكُمْ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لَكِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا نُقَبِّلُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَأَمْلِكُ إِنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ نَزَعَ مِنْكُمُ الرَّحْمَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ‏"‏ مِنْ قَلْبِكَ الرَّحْمَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, they said: Abu Usamah and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from 'A'ishah, she said: Some Bedouin people came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: "Do you kiss your children?" They said: "Yes." They said: "But by Allah, we do not kiss them." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Can I help it if Allah has stripped mercy from you?" And Ibn Numayr said: "mercy from your heart?"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2318 a, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ الأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ، أَبْصَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَبِّلُ الْحَسَنَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ لِي عَشَرَةً مِنَ الْوَلَدِ مَا قَبَّلْتُ وَاحِدًا مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمْ لاَ يُرْحَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid and Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to me, both from Sufyan; 'Amr said: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, that al-Aqra' ibn Habis saw the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) kissing al-Hasan, so he said: "Indeed, I have ten children, and I have never kissed a single one of them." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2318 b, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us, Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri: Abu Salamah narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2319 a, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، وَأَبِي، ظِبْيَانَ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمِ النَّاسَ لاَ يَرْحَمْهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, both from Jarir; (H) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and 'Ali ibn Khashram narrated to us, they said: 'Isa ibn Yunus informed us; (H) and Abu Kurayb, Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' narrated to us, Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us; (H) and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to us, Hafs—meaning Ibn Ghiyath—narrated to us, all of them from al-A'mash, from Zayd ibn Wahb and Abu Zibyan, from Jarir ibn 'Abdullah, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Whoever does not show mercy to people, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will not show mercy to him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2319 b, book 43, باب رَحْمَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصِّبْيَانَ وَالْعِيَالَ وَتَوَاضُعِهِ وَفَضْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الأَعْمَشِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Waki' and 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Isma'il, from Qays, from Jarir, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); (H) and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Abi 'Umar, and Ahmad ibn 'Abdah narrated to us, they said: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr, from Jarir, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of the hadith of al-A'mash.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2320, book 43, باب كَثْرَةِ حَيَائِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، بْنَ أَبِي عُتْبَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي عُتْبَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَشَدَّ حَيَاءً مِنَ الْعَذْرَاءِ فِي خِدْرِهَا وَكَانَ إِذَا كَرِهَ شَيْئًا عَرَفْنَاهُ فِي وَجْهِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated to me, my father narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah: he heard 'Abdullah ibn Abi 'Utbah narrating from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; (H) and Zuhayr ibn Harb, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and Ahmad ibn Sinan narrated to us—Zuhayr said: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, he said: I heard 'Abdullah ibn Abi 'Utbah saying: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was more modest than a virgin in her private chamber; and whenever he disliked something, we would recognize it in his face.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2321 a, book 43, باب كَثْرَةِ حَيَائِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو حِينَ قَدِمَ مُعَاوِيَةُ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ فَذَكَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ فَاحِشًا وَلاَ مُتَفَحِّشًا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حِينَ قَدِمَ مَعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, they said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq, from Masruq, he said: We entered upon 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr when Mu'awiyah came to Kufa. He mentioned the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: "He was neither obscene in speech nor did he deliberately utter obscenities." And he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, among the best of you are those of you with the best character." 'Uthman said: "when he arrived with Mu'awiyah at Kufa."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2321 b, book 43, باب كَثْرَةِ حَيَائِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي الأَحْمَرَ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us, Abu Mu'awiyah and Waki' narrated to us; (H) and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, my father narrated to us; (H) and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to us, Abu Khalid—meaning al-Ahmar—narrated to us, all of them from al-A'mash, with this chain of transmission, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2322, book 43, باب تَبَسُّمِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحُسْنِ عِشْرَتِهِ ‏.‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِجَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ أَكُنْتَ تُجَالِسُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ كَثِيرًا كَانَ لاَ يَقُومُ مِنْ مُصَلاَّهُ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي فِيهِ الصُّبْحَ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَإِذَا طَلَعَتْ قَامَ وَكَانُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ فَيَأْخُذُونَ فِي أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَيَضْحَكُونَ وَيَتَبَسَّمُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, Abu Khaythamah informed us, from Simak ibn Harb, he said: I said to Jabir ibn Samurah: "Did you use to sit with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)?" He said: "Yes, frequently. He would not stand up from his prayer-place where he prayed the morning prayer (Fajr) until the sun rose; when it rose, he would stand up. And they would converse, discussing affairs of the pre-Islamic period of ignorance and laughing, while he (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) would smile."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2323 a, book 43, باب فِي رَحْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنِّسَاءِ وَأَمْرِ السُّوَّاقِ مَطَايَاهُنَّ بِالرِّفْقِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَحَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ وَغُلاَمٌ أَسْوَدُ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَنْجَشَةُ يَحْدُو فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَنْجَشَةُ رُوَيْدَكَ سَوْقًا بِالْقَوَارِيرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Rabi' al-'Ataki, Hamid ibn 'Umar, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Abu Kamil narrated to us, all from Hammad ibn Zayd; Abu al-Rabi' said: Hammad narrated to us, Ayyub narrated to us, from Abu Qilabah, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was on one of his journeys, and a black boy named Anjashah was singing camel songs to urge them on. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: "O Anjashah, go gently in driving the glass vessels!"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2323 b, book 43, باب فِي رَحْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنِّسَاءِ وَأَمْرِ السُّوَّاقِ مَطَايَاهُنَّ بِالرِّفْقِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَحَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Rabi' al-'Ataki, Hamid ibn 'Umar, and Abu Kamil narrated to us, they said: Hammad narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas, similar to it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2323 c, book 43, باب فِي رَحْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنِّسَاءِ وَأَمْرِ السُّوَّاقِ مَطَايَاهُنَّ بِالرِّفْقِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَسَوَّاقٌ يَسُوقُ بِهِنَّ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَنْجَشَةُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ يَا أَنْجَشَةُ رُوَيْدًا سَوْقَكَ بِالْقَوَارِيرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ تَكَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَلِمَةٍ لَوْ تَكَلَّمَ بِهَا بَعْضُكُمْ لَعِبْتُمُوهَا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, both from Ibn 'Ulayyah; Zuhayr said: Isma'il narrated to us, Ayyub narrated to us, from Abu Qilabah, from Anas, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) came upon his wives while a camel-driver called Anjashah was driving their camels fast, so he said: "Woe to you, O Anjashah! Go gently in driving the glass vessels." He said: Abu Qilabah said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) spoke a word which, had one of you uttered it, you would have criticized him for it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2323 d, book 43, باب فِي رَحْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنِّسَاءِ وَأَمْرِ السُّوَّاقِ مَطَايَاهُنَّ بِالرِّفْقِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ مَعَ نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُنَّ يَسُوقُ بِهِنَّ سَوَّاقٌ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَىْ أَنْجَشَةُ رُوَيْدًا سَوْقَكَ بِالْقَوَارِيرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, Yazid ibn Zuray' informed us, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Anas ibn Malik; (H) and Abu Kamil narrated to us, Yazid narrated to us, al-Taymi narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: Umm Sulaym was with the wives of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and a camel-driver was driving them fast. The Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "O Anjashah, go gently in driving the glass vessels!"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2323 e, book 43, باب فِي رَحْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنِّسَاءِ وَأَمْرِ السُّوَّاقِ مَطَايَاهُنَّ بِالرِّفْقِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَادٍ حَسَنُ الصَّوْتِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ رُوَيْدًا يَا أَنْجَشَةُ لاَ تَكْسِرِ الْقَوَارِيرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي ضَعَفَةَ النِّسَاءِ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, 'Abd al-Samad narrated to us, Hammam narrated to me, Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas, he said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) had a camel-driver with a beautiful voice, so the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: "Slowly, O Anjashah! Do not break the glass vessels"—meaning the delicate women.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2323 f, book 43, باب فِي رَحْمَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنِّسَاءِ وَأَمْرِ السُّوَّاقِ مَطَايَاهُنَّ بِالرِّفْقِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَادٍ حَسَنُ الصَّوْتِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Ibn Bashshar narrated it to us, Abu Dawud narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he did not mention: "a camel-driver with a beautiful voice."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2324, book 43, باب قُرْبِ النَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَتَبَرُّكِهِمْ بِهِ ‏.‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّضْرِ وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، - يَعْنِي هَاشِمَ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ جَاءَ خَدَمُ الْمَدِينَةِ بِآنِيَتِهِمْ فِيهَا الْمَاءُ فَمَا يُؤْتَى بِإِنَاءٍ إِلاَّ غَمَسَ يَدَهُ فِيهَا فَرُبَّمَا جَاءُوهُ فِي الْغَدَاةِ الْبَارِدَةِ فَيَغْمِسُ يَدَهُ فِيهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Mujahid ibn Musa, Abu Bakr ibn al-Nadr ibn Abi al-Nadr, and Harun ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us, all from Abu al-Nadr; Abu Bakr said: Abu al-Nadr—meaning Hashim ibn al-Qasim—narrated to us, Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik, he said: When the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) had prayed the morning prayer (Fajr), the servants of Medina would bring their vessels containing water, and no vessel was brought to him except that he dipped his hand in it. Sometimes they would bring them to him on a cold morning, and he would still dip his hand in it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2325, book 43, باب قُرْبِ النَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَتَبَرُّكِهِمْ بِهِ ‏.‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْحَلاَّقُ يَحْلِقُهُ وَأَطَافَ بِهِ أَصْحَابُهُ فَمَا يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَقَعَ شَعْرَةٌ إِلاَّ فِي يَدِ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to us, Abu al-Nadr narrated to us, Sulayman narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas, he said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) while the barber was shaving him, and his Companions were encircling him, desiring that not a single hair should fall except into the hand of a man.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2326, book 43, باب قُرْبِ النَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَتَبَرُّكِهِمْ بِهِ ‏.‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، كَانَ فِي عَقْلِهَا شَىْءٌ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي إِلَيْكَ حَاجَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ فُلاَنٍ انْظُرِي أَىَّ السِّكَكِ شِئْتِ حَتَّى أَقْضِيَ لَكِ حَاجَتَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَلاَ مَعَهَا فِي بَعْضِ الطُّرُقِ حَتَّى فَرَغَتْ مِنْ حَاجَتِهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas, that a woman had some mental deficiency, so she said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have a need from you." He said: "O mother of so-and-so, see whichever side-street you wish, so that I may fulfill your need for you." So he stood alone with her in one of the pathways until she finished presenting her need.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2327 a, book 43, باب مُبَاعَدَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلآثَامِ وَاخْتِيَارِهِ مِنَ الْمُبَاحِ أَسْهَلَهُ وَانْتِقَامِهِ ل
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ، يَحْيَى قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا خُيِّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ إِلاَّ أَخَذَ أَيْسَرَهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ إِثْمًا فَإِنْ كَانَ إِثْمًا كَانَ أَبْعَدَ النَّاسِ مِنْهُ وَمَا انْتَقَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِنَفْسِهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تُنْتَهَكَ حُرْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas in what was recited to him; (H) and Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, he said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from 'A'ishah, wife of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that she said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was never given the choice between two matters except that he took the easier of them, as long as it was not a sin. But if it was a sin, he was the furthest of people from it. Nor did the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) ever take revenge for himself, unless a sanctity of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, was violated.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2327 b, book 43, باب مُبَاعَدَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلآثَامِ وَاخْتِيَارِهِ مِنَ الْمُبَاحِ أَسْهَلَهُ وَانْتِقَامِهِ ل
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، بْنُ عَبْدَةَ حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، فِي رِوَايَةِ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ جَرِيرٍ مُحَمَّدٍ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, both from Jarir; (H) and Ahmad ibn 'Abdah narrated to us, Fudayl ibn 'Iyad narrated to us, both from Mansur, from Muhammad—in the narration of Fudayl: Ibn Shihab, and in the narration of Jarir: Muhammad al-Zuhri—from 'Urwah, from 'A'ishah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2327 c, book 43, باب مُبَاعَدَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلآثَامِ وَاخْتِيَارِهِ مِنَ الْمُبَاحِ أَسْهَلَهُ وَانْتِقَامِهِ ل
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
en_text: And Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated it to me, Ibn Wahb informed us, Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain of transmission, similar to the hadith of Malik.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2327 d, book 43, باب مُبَاعَدَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلآثَامِ وَاخْتِيَارِهِ مِنَ الْمُبَاحِ أَسْهَلَهُ وَانْتِقَامِهِ ل
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا خُيِّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَيْسَرُ مِنَ الآخَرِ إِلاَّ اخْتَارَ أَيْسَرَهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ إِثْمًا فَإِنْ كَانَ إِثْمًا كَانَ أَبْعَدَ النَّاسِ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from 'A'ishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was never given the choice between two matters, one being easier than the other, except that he chose the easier of them, as long as it was not a sin. But if it was a sin, he was the furthest of people from it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2327 e, book 43, باب مُبَاعَدَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلآثَامِ وَاخْتِيَارِهِ مِنَ الْمُبَاحِ أَسْهَلَهُ وَانْتِقَامِهِ ل
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ أَيْسَرَهُمَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Kurayb and Ibn Numayr both narrated it to us from 'Abdullah ibn Numayr, from Hisham, with this chain of transmission up to his words: "the easier of the two." And they did not mention what followed it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2328 a, book 43, باب مُبَاعَدَتِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلآثَامِ وَاخْتِيَارِهِ مِنَ الْمُبَاحِ أَسْهَلَهُ وَانْتِقَامِهِ ل
text_original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا قَطُّ بِيَدِهِ وَلاَ امْرَأَةً وَلاَ خَادِمًا إِلاَّ أَنْ يُجَاهِدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نِيلَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ قَطُّ فَيَنْتَقِمَ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُنْتَهَكَ شَىْءٌ مِنْ مَحَارِمِ اللَّهِ فَيَنْتَقِمَ لِلَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb narrated it to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from 'A'ishah, she said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) never struck anything with his hand—neither a woman nor a servant—except when fighting in the cause of Allah. Nor was he ever wronged in anything so as to take revenge upon its perpetrator, unless something from the sanctities of Allah was violated, in which case he would take revenge for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
