en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari narrated to us: My father narrated to us: Abu Yunus narrated to us, from Simak, who said: Al-Nu'man ibn Bashir delivered a sermon and said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a man who loaded his provisions and water skin onto a camel, then journeyed until he reached a desolate land; then the midday heat overtook him, so he dismounted and took a midday nap under a tree. Sleep overcame him and his camel slipped away. He woke up and ran up an elevated hill, but saw nothing; then he ran up a second elevated hill, but saw nothing; then he ran up a third elevated hill, but saw nothing. So he returned until he reached the spot where he had taken his midday nap. While he was sitting, suddenly his camel came walking toward him until it placed its halter into his hand. Surely Allah is more pleased with the repentance of the servant than this man when he found his camel in its state." Simak said: Al-Sha'bi claimed that al-Nu'man attributed this hadith to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), but as for me, I did not hear it [attributed to him].

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2746, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادِ بْنِ لَقِيطٍ، عَنْ إِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَقُولُونَ بِفَرَحِ رَجُلٍ انْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ تَجُرُّ زِمَامَهَا بِأَرْضٍ قَفْرٍ لَيْسَ بِهَا طَعَامٌ وَلاَ شَرَابٌ وَعَلَيْهَا لَهُ طَعَامٌ وَشَرَابٌ فَطَلَبَهَا حَتَّى شَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَرَّتْ بِجِذْلِ شَجَرَةٍ فَتَعَلَّقَ زِمَامُهَا فَوَجَدَهَا مُتَعَلِّقَةً بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا شَدِيدًا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ بِرَاحِلَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ja'far ibn Humayd narrated to us; Ja'far said: He narrated to us, and Yahya said: 'Ubaydullah ibn Iyad ibn Laqit informed us, from Iyad, from al-Bara' ibn 'Azib, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "What do you say about the joy of a man whose riding camel escaped from him, dragging its halter in a barren land in which there is neither food nor drink, while bearing for him his food and drink; so he searched for it until it became exhausting for him, then it passed by the stump of a tree and its halter got caught, so he found it entangled by it?" We said: "Very great joy, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, by Allah, Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant than the man with his riding camel." Ja'far said: 'Ubaydullah ibn Iyad narrated to us from his father.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2747 a, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، - وَهُوَ عَمُّهُ - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ كَانَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ فَانْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَأَيِسَ مِنْهَا فَأَتَى شَجَرَةً فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي ظِلِّهَا قَدْ أَيِسَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا هُوَ بِهَا قَائِمَةً عِنْدَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِخِطَامِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَأَنَا رَبُّكَ ‏.‏ أَخْطَأَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Sabbah and Zuhayr ibn Harb both narrated to us: 'Umar ibn Yunus narrated to us: 'Ikrimah ibn 'Ammar narrated to us: Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah narrated to us: Anas ibn Malik—and he was his uncle—narrated to us, saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant when he repents to Him than one of you who was on his riding camel in a desert land and it escaped from him carrying his food and drink, so he despaired of it. He came to a tree and lay down in its shade, having despaired of his riding camel. While he was in that state, lo, it was standing right before him! So he took hold of its nose-rope and then said out of extreme joy: 'O Allah, You are my servant and I am your Lord!' He erred out of extreme joy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2747 b, c, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ قَدْ أَضَلَّهُ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ، مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Haddab ibn Khalid narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant than one of you when he awakens finding his camel which he had lost in a desolate land." And Ahmad al-Darimi narrated it to me: Habban narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us: Anas ibn Malik narrated to us, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2748 a, book 50, باب سُقُوطِ الذُّنُوبِ بِالاِسْتِغْفَارِ تَوْبَةً ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، - قَاصِّ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ - عَنْ أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ حَضَرَتْهُ الْوَفَاةُ كُنْتُ كَتَمْتُ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّكُمْ تُذْنِبُونَ لَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ خَلْقًا يُذْنِبُونَ يَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Qays—the storyteller of 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz—from Abu Sirmah, from Abu Ayyub, that he said when death approached him: I had concealed from you something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Were it not that you commit sins, Allah would create a creation who commit sins and He forgives them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2748 b, book 50, باب سُقُوطِ الذُّنُوبِ بِالاِسْتِغْفَارِ تَوْبَةً ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِيَاضٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفِهْرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبٌ يَغْفِرُهَا اللَّهُ لَكُمْ لَجَاءَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ لَهُمْ ذُنُوبٌ يَغْفِرُهَا لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to us: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: 'Iyad—and he is Ibn 'Abdullah al-Fihri—narrated to me: Ibrahim ibn 'Ubayd ibn Rifa'ah narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi, from Abu Sirmah, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: "Were it not that you had sins that Allah forgives for you, Allah would bring a people who have sins that He forgives for them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2749, book 50, باب سُقُوطِ الذُّنُوبِ بِالاِسْتِغْفَارِ تَوْبَةً ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ الْجَزَرِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ لَمْ تُذْنِبُوا لَذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ وَلَجَاءَ بِقَوْمٍ يُذْنِبُونَ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ فَيَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to me: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma'mar informed us, from Ja'far al-Jazari, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "By Him in Whose Hand is my soul, if you did not commit sins, Allah would do away with you and bring a people who commit sins, so that they seek forgiveness from Allah and He forgives them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2750 a, book 50, بَاب فَضْلِ دَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ وَالْفِكْرِ فِي أُمُورِ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَجَوَازِ تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالِاشْتِغَالِ بِالدُّنْيَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَقَطَنُ بْنُ نُسَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ، بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ الأُسَيِّدِيِّ، قَالَ - وَكَانَ مِنْ كُتَّابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ - لَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ أَنْتَ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مَا تَقُولُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَكُونُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُذَكِّرُنَا بِالنَّارِ وَالْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّا رَأْىَ عَيْنٍ فَإِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَافَسْنَا الأَزْوَاجَ وَالأَوْلاَدَ وَالضَّيْعَاتِ فَنَسِينَا كَثِيرًا قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَلْقَى مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَكُونُ عِنْدَكَ تُذَكِّرُنَا بِالنَّارِ وَالْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّا رَأْىَ عَيْنٍ فَإِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَافَسْنَا الأَزْوَاجَ وَالأَوْلاَدَ وَالضَّيْعَاتِ نَسِينَا كَثِيرًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنْ لَوْ تَدُومُونَ عَلَى مَا تَكُونُونَ عِنْدِي وَفِي الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عَلَى فُرُشِكُمْ وَفِي طُرُقِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةً وَسَاعَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi and Qatan ibn Nusayr—and the wording is Yahya's—narrated to us; Ja'far ibn Sulayman informed us, from Sa'id ibn Iyas al-Jurayri, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Hanzalah al-Usayyidi—he said: and he was one of the scribes of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)—who said: Abu Bakr met me and said: "How are you, O Hanzalah?" He said: I said: "Hanzalah has become a hypocrite." He said: "Subhan Allah! What are you saying?" He said: I said: "We are in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); he reminds us of the Fire and Paradise until it is as though we see them with our own eyes. But when we leave the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), we busy ourselves with our wives, children, and properties, and we forget much." Abu Bakr said: "By Allah, we also experience the like of this." So I and Abu Bakr set off until we entered upon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). I said: "Hanzalah has become a hypocrite, O Messenger of Allah!" The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "And what is that?" I said: "O Messenger of Allah, we are in your presence and you remind us of the Fire and Paradise until it is as though we see them with our own eyes. But when we leave your presence, we busy ourselves with our wives, children, and properties, and we forget much." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "By Him in Whose Hand is my soul, if you were to remain constantly in the state you are in while with me and in remembrance, the angels would shake hands with you on your beds and in your paths; but, O Hanzalah, an hour and an hour"—three times.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2750 b, book 50, بَاب فَضْلِ دَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ وَالْفِكْرِ فِي أُمُورِ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَجَوَازِ تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالِاشْتِغَالِ بِالدُّنْيَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَعَظَنَا فَذَكَّرَ النَّارَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ جِئْتُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَضَاحَكْتُ الصِّبْيَانَ وَلاَعَبْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ - قَالَ - فَخَرَجْتُ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ وَأَنَا قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا تَذْكُرُ ‏.‏ فَلَقِينَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ بِالْحَدِيثِ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَنَا قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةً وَسَاعَةً وَلَوْ كَانَتْ تَكُونُ قُلُوبُكُمْ كَمَا تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ حَتَّى تُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الطُّرُقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me: 'Abd al-Samad informed us: I heard my father narrating: Sa'id al-Jurayri narrated to us, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Hanzalah, who said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he admonished us and reminded [us of] the Fire. He said: Then I came to the house, laughed with the children, and played with the woman (my wife). He said: Then I went out and met Abu Bakr, and I mentioned that to him. He said: "And I have done the like of what you mention." So we met the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and I said: "O Messenger of Allah, Hanzalah has become a hypocrite!" He said: "Hold on!" So I narrated the account to him. Then Abu Bakr said: "And I have done the like of what he did." He said: "O Hanzalah, an hour and an hour; and if your hearts remained as they are during the remembrance, the angels would shake hands with you until they greet you with peace in the streets."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2750 c, book 50, بَاب فَضْلِ دَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ وَالْفِكْرِ فِي أُمُورِ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَجَوَازِ تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالِاشْتِغَالِ بِالدُّنْيَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ التَّمِيمِيِّ الأُسَيِّدِيِّ الْكَاتِبِ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَّرَنَا الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Hanzalah al-Tamimi al-Usayyidi, the scribe, who said: We were with the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he reminded us of Paradise and the Fire... and he mentioned similar to their hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2751 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَمَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ فَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Al-Mughirah—meaning al-Hizami—narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "When Allah created the creation, He wrote in His Book, which is with Him above the Throne: 'Indeed, My mercy prevails over My wrath.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2751 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَبَقَتْ رَحْمَتِي غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'My mercy has preceded My wrath.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2751 c, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ مِينَاءَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَهُوَ مَوْضُوعٌ عِنْدَهُ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Khashram narrated to us: Abu Damrah informed us, from al-Harith ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Ata' ibn Mina', from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "When Allah decreed the creation, He wrote in His Book upon Himself, and it is placed with Him: 'Indeed, My mercy prevails over My wrath.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2752 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ تَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلاَئِقُ حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ الدَّابَّةُ حَافِرَهَا عَنْ وَلَدِهَا خَشْيَةَ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi narrated to us: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab informed him that Abu Hurayrah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Allah made mercy into one hundred parts. He kept ninety-nine parts with Himself and sent down one single part to the earth. From that single part, all creatures show mercy to one another, until a mare lifts its hoof from its foal out of fear that it might harm it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2752 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَوَضَعَ وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ وَخَبَأَ عِنْدَهُ مِائَةً إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr said: Isma'il—meaning Ibn Ja'far—narrated to us, from al-'Ala', from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah created one hundred mercies; He placed one among His creation and concealed with Himself one hundred less one."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2752 c, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ أَنْزَلَ مِنْهَا رَحْمَةً وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ وَالْهَوَامِّ فَبِهَا يَتَعَاطَفُونَ وَبِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُونَ وَبِهَا تَعْطِفُ الْوَحْشُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَأَخَّرَ اللَّهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً يَرْحَمُ بِهَا عِبَادَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us: My father narrated to us: 'Abd al-Malik narrated to us, from 'Ata', from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "Indeed, Allah has one hundred mercies. He sent down one mercy thereof among the jinn, humans, beasts, and vermin, by which they show affection, by which they show mercy to one another, and by which the wild beast shows compassion to its child; and Allah has reserved ninety-nine mercies with which He will show mercy to His servants on the Day of Resurrection."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2753 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَمِنْهَا رَحْمَةٌ بِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَتِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hakam ibn Musa narrated to me: Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh narrated to us: Sulayman al-Taymi narrated to us: Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi narrated to us, from Salman al-Farsi, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, Allah has one hundred mercies; among them is one mercy by which creation shows mercy among themselves, and ninety-nine are for the Day of Resurrection."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2753 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated it to us: Al-Mu'tamir narrated to us, from his father, with this chain of transmission.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2753 c, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ كُلُّ رَحْمَةٍ طِبَاقَ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ فَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا فِي الأَرْضِ رَحْمَةً فَبِهَا تَعْطِفُ الْوَالِدَةُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَالْوَحْشُ وَالطَّيْرُ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أَكْمَلَهَا بِهَذِهِ الرَّحْمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Numayr narrated to us: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from Abu 'Uthman, from Salman, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, on the day He created the heavens and the earth, Allah created one hundred mercies, each mercy spanning what is between the heaven and the earth. He placed one mercy thereof on the earth, and through it the mother shows compassion to her child, and the wild beasts and birds show compassion to one another. When the Day of Resurrection comes, He will complete them with this mercy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2754, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَسَنٍ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَبْىٍ فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ السَّبْىِ تَبْتَغِي إِذَا وَجَدَتْ صَبِيًّا فِي السَّبْىِ أَخَذَتْهُ فَأَلْصَقَتْهُ بِبَطْنِهَا وَأَرْضَعَتْهُ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَرَوْنَ هَذِهِ الْمَرْأَةَ طَارِحَةً وَلَدَهَا فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ وَاللَّهِ وَهِيَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ تَطْرَحَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ بِوَلَدِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Hulwani and Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Tamimi—and the wording is Hasan's—narrated to me: Ibn Abi Maryam narrated to us: Abu Ghassan narrated to us: Zayd ibn Aslam narrated to me, from his father, from 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, that he said: Some captives were brought to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and there was a woman among the captives searching [for her child]. When she found an infant among the captives, she took it, pressed it to her belly, and suckled it. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to us: "Do you think this woman would throw her child into the fire?" We said: "No, by Allah, while she is able not to throw it." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah is surely more merciful to His servants than this woman is to her child."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2755, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْعُقُوبَةِ مَا طَمِعَ بِجَنَّتِهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْكَافِرُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ مَا قَنِطَ مِنْ جَنَّتِهِ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr all narrated to us from Isma'il ibn Ja'far; Ibn Ayyub said: Isma'il narrated to us: Al-'Ala' informed me, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "If the believer knew what is with Allah of punishment, no one would covet His Paradise; and if the disbeliever knew what is with Allah of mercy, no one would despair of His Paradise."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2756 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقِ ابْنِ بِنْتِ مَهْدِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ حَسَنَةً قَطُّ لأَهْلِهِ إِذَا مَاتَ فَحَرِّقُوهُ ثُمَّ اذْرُوا نِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَنِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ لَيُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا لاَ يُعَذِّبُهُ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ فَعَلُوا مَا أَمَرَهُمْ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَرَّ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ وَأَمَرَ الْبَحْرَ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا قَالَ مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Marzuq, grandson of the daughter of Mahdi ibn Maymun, narrated to me: Rawh narrated to us: Malik narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "A man who had never done any good said to his family: 'When he dies, burn him, then scatter half of him on land and half of him in the sea; for, by Allah, if Allah takes hold of him, He will surely punish him with a punishment with which He does not punish anyone in the worlds.' When the man died, they did what he commanded them. Then Allah commanded the land, and it gathered what was in it, and He commanded the sea, and it gathered what was in it. Then He said: 'Why did you do this?' He said: 'Out of fear of You, O Lord, and You know best.' So Allah forgave him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2756 b, 2619 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ الزُّهْرِيُّ أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثَيْنِ عَجِيبَيْنِ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْرَفَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ أَوْصَى بَنِيهِ فَقَالَ إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي ثُمَّ اسْحَقُونِي ثُمَّ اذْرُونِي فِي الرِّيحِ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ عَلَىَّ رَبِّي لَيُعَذِّبُنِي عَذَابًا مَا عَذَّبَهُ بِهِ أَحَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهِ فَقَالَ لِلأَرْضِ أَدِّي مَا أَخَذْتِ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا هُوَ قَائِمٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ فَقَالَ خَشْيَتُكَ يَا رَبِّ - أَوْ قَالَ - مَخَافَتُكَ ‏.‏ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ بِذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَحَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ رَبَطَتْهَا فَلاَ هِيَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا وَلاَ هِيَ أَرْسَلَتْهَا تَأْكُلُ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الأَرْضِ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ هَزْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ ذَلِكَ لِئَلاَّ يَتَّكِلَ رَجُلٌ وَلاَ يَيْأَسَ رَجُلٌ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us; 'Abd said: He informed us, and Ibn Rafi' said—and the wording is his: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma'mar informed us, saying: Al-Zuhri said to me: Shall I not narrate to you two wondrous hadiths? Al-Zuhri said: Humayd ibn 'Abd al-Rahman informed me, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "A man transgressed against himself, and when death approached him, he instructed his sons, saying: 'When I die, burn me, then grind me, then scatter me in the wind into the sea; for, by Allah, if my Lord takes hold of me, He will surely punish me with a punishment with which He has not punished anyone.' He said: So they did that to him. Then He said to the earth: 'Deliver up what you took.' And lo, he was standing upright. He said to him: 'What prompted you to do what you did?' He said: 'Fear of You, O Lord'—or he said—'fear of You.' So He forgave him because of that." Al-Zuhri said: And Humayd narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "A woman entered the Fire on account of a cat that she tied up; she neither fed it nor released it to eat from the vermin of the earth, until it died of starvation." Al-Zuhri said: That is so that no man should rely complacently, nor should any man despair.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2756 c, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَسْرَفَ عَبْدٌ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَدِيثَ الْمَرْأَةِ فِي قِصَّةِ الْهِرَّةِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ أَخَذَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا أَدِّ مَا أَخَذْتَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Rabi' Sulayman ibn Dawud narrated to me: Muhammad ibn Harb narrated to us: Al-Zubaydi narrated to me: Al-Zuhri said: Humayd ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "A servant transgressed against himself..." similar to the hadith of Ma'mar up to his words: "so Allah forgave him." And he did not mention the hadith of the woman in the story of the cat. And in the hadith of al-Zubaydi, he said: "So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said to everything that took something from him: 'Deliver up what you took from him.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2757 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْغَافِرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ رَاشَهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا فَقَالَ لِوَلَدِهِ لَتَفْعَلُنَّ مَا آمُرُكُمْ بِهِ أَوْ لأُوَلِّيَنَّ مِيرَاثِي غَيْرَكُمْ إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي - وَأَكْثَرُ عِلْمِي أَنَّهُ قَالَ - ثُمَّ اسْحَقُونِي وَاذْرُونِي فِي الرِّيحِ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَبْتَهِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَىَّ أَنْ يُعَذِّبَنِي - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَرَبِّي فَقَالَ اللَّهُ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتَ فَقَالَ مَخَافَتُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا تَلاَفَاهُ غَيْرُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari narrated to me: My father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah: He heard 'Uqbah ibn 'Abd al-Ghafir saying: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri narrating from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): "There was a man among those who were before you to whom Allah had granted wealth and children. He said to his children: 'You must certainly do what I command you to do, or else I will assign my inheritance to other than you. When I die, burn me'—and to the best of my knowledge he said—'then grind me and scatter me in the wind, for I have not preserved any good with Allah, and if Allah takes hold of me He will punish me.' He said: So he took a covenant from them, and they did that to him, by my Lord! Then Allah said: 'What prompted you to do what you did?' He said: 'Fear of You.' He said: And nothing spared him except that."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2757 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، ذَكَرُوا جَمِيعًا بِإِسْنَادِ شُعْبَةَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ وَأَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ النَّاسِ رَغَسَهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ التَّيْمِيِّ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَّرَهَا قَتَادَةُ لَمْ يَدَّخِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا ابْتَأَرَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏"‏ مَا امْتَأَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِالْمِيمِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi narrated it to us: Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman narrated to us, saying: My father said to me: Qatadah narrated to us; (H) and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Al-Hasan ibn Musa narrated to us: Shayban ibn 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to us; (H) and Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Abu al-Walid narrated to us: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, both from Qatadah; they all mentioned with the chain of transmission of Shu'bah similar to his hadith. And in the hadith of Shayban and Abu 'Awanah: "that a man among the people was granted by Allah abundant wealth and children." And in the hadith of al-Taymi: "for he had not stored up with Allah any good." He said: Qatadah explained it: "he had not preserved with Allah any good." And in the hadith of Shayban: "for, by Allah, he had not stored up (ibta'ara) with Allah any good." And in the hadith of Abu 'Awanah: "had not stored up (imta'ara)" with the letter mim.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2758 a, book 50, باب قَبُولِ التَّوْبَةِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَإِنْ تَكَرَّرَتِ الذُّنُوبُ وَالتَّوْبَةُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا يَحْكِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَذْنَبَ عَبْدٌ ذَنْبًا فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَذْنَبَ عَبْدِي ذَنْبًا فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَادَ فَأَذْنَبَ فَقَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى عَبْدِي أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَادَ فَأَذْنَبَ فَقَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَذْنَبَ عَبْدِي ذَنْبًا فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ وَاعْمَلْ مَا شِئْتَ فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى لاَ أَدْرِي أَقَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ اعْمَلْ مَا شِئْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd al-A'la ibn Hammad narrated to me: Hammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Amrah, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), regarding what he related from his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, who said: "A servant committed a sin and said: 'O Allah, forgive me my sin.' So He, Blessed and Exalted, said: 'My servant committed a sin and knew that he has a Lord Who forgives sin and takes to account for sin.' Then he returned and committed a sin, saying: 'O my Lord, forgive me my sin.' So He, Blessed and Exalted, said: 'My servant committed a sin and knew that he has a Lord Who forgives sin and takes to account for sin.' Then he returned and committed a sin, saying: 'O my Lord, forgive me my sin.' So He, Blessed and Exalted, said: 'My servant committed a sin and knew that he has a Lord Who forgives sin and takes to account for sin; do whatever you will, for I have forgiven you.'" 'Abd al-A'la said: I do not know whether he said in the third or fourth time: "Do whatever you will."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2758 b, book 50, باب قَبُولِ التَّوْبَةِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَإِنْ تَكَرَّرَتِ الذُّنُوبُ وَالتَّوْبَةُ ‏‏
text_original: قَالَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَنْجُويَهْ الْقُرَشِيُّ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، بْنُ حَمَّادٍ النَّرْسِيُّ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Ahmad said: Muhammad ibn Zanjawayh al-Qurashi al-Qushayri narrated to me: 'Abd al-A'la ibn Hammad al-Narsi narrated to us with this chain of transmission.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2758 c, book 50, باب قَبُولِ التَّوْبَةِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَإِنْ تَكَرَّرَتِ الذُّنُوبُ وَالتَّوْبَةُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ قَالَ كَانَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ قَاصٌّ يُقَالُ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ - قَالَ - فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ عَبْدًا أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏"‏ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي الثَّالِثَةِ ‏"‏ قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي فَلْيَعْمَلْ مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me: Abu al-Walid narrated to me: Hammam narrated to us: Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah narrated to us, who said: There was a storyteller in Medina called 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Amrah; he said: I heard him saying: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "A servant committed a sin..." with the meaning of the hadith of Hammad ibn Salamah. And he mentioned three times: "he committed a sin," and in the third: "I have forgiven My servant, so let him do whatever he wills."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2759 a, b, book 50, باب قَبُولِ التَّوْبَةِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَإِنْ تَكَرَّرَتِ الذُّنُوبُ وَالتَّوْبَةُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Amr ibn Murrah, who said: I heard Aba 'Ubaydah narrating from Abu Musa, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, stretches out His Hand by night so that the sinner of the day may repent, and He stretches out His Hand by day so that the sinner of the night may repent, until the sun rises from its setting place." And Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Abu Dawud narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us with this chain of transmission similar to it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2760 a, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ مَدَحَ نَفْسَهُ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us; Ishaq said: Jarir informed us, and 'Uthman said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from 'Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "There is no one to whom praise is more beloved than Allah; for that reason He praised Himself. And there is no one possessing more protective jealousy than Allah; for that reason He forbade immoralities."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2760 b, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr and Abu Kurayb both narrated to us: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us; (H) and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us—and the wording is his: 'Abdullah ibn Numayr and Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq, from 'Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "There is no one possessing more protective jealousy than Allah; and for that reason He forbade immoralities, both the apparent of them and the concealed. And there is no one to whom praise is more beloved than Allah."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2760 c, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ قُلْتُ لَهُ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَعَمْ وَرَفَعَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلِذَلِكَ مَدَحَ نَفْسَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar both narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Amr ibn Murrah, who said: I heard Aba Wa'il saying: I heard 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud saying: I asked him: Did you hear it from 'Abdullah? He said: Yes, and he traced it back [to the Prophet], that he said: "There is no one possessing more protective jealousy than Allah; and for that reason He forbade immoralities, both the apparent of them and the concealed. And there is no one to whom praise is more beloved than Allah; and for that reason He praised Himself."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2760 d, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ مَدَحَ نَفْسَهُ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْعُذْرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ وَأَرْسَلَ الرُّسُلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us; Ishaq said: Jarir informed us, and the other two said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Malik ibn al-Harith, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "There is no one to whom praise is more beloved than Allah, the Mighty and Majestic; for that reason He praised Himself. And there is no one possessing more protective jealousy than Allah; for that reason He forbade immoralities. And there is no one to whom excuse is more beloved than Allah; for that reason He sent down the Book and dispatched the messengers."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2761 a, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ قَالَ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغَارُ وَإِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَغَارُ وَغَيْرَةُ اللَّهِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُ مَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to us: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim Ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, from Hajjaj ibn Abi 'Uthman, who said: Yahya said: And Abu Salamah narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, Allah possesses protective jealousy, and indeed, the believer possesses protective jealousy; and the protective jealousy of Allah is that a believer should commit what He has forbidden to him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2761 b, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَحَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ رِوَايَةِ حَجَّاجٍ حَدِيثَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ خَاصَّةً وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَدِيثَ أَسْمَاءَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Abu Dawud narrated to us: Aban ibn Yazid and Harb ibn Shaddad narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), similar to the narration of Hajjaj, the hadith of Abu Hurayrah specifically, and he did not mention the hadith of Asma'.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2761 c, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَغَارُ وَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ غَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: 'Abd al-'Aziz—meaning Ibn Muhammad—narrated to us, from al-'Ala', from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "The believer possesses protective jealousy, and Allah is even more jealous."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2761 d, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, saying: I heard al-'Ala' with this chain of transmission.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2762 a, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ شَىْءٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya said: And Abu Salamah narrated to me that 'Urwah ibn al-Zubayr narrated to him that Asma' bint Abi Bakr narrated to him that she heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "There is nothing possessing more protective jealousy than Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2762 b, book 50, باب غَيْرَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَحْرِيمِ الْفَوَاحِشِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ شَىْءَ أَغْيَرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami narrated to us: Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal narrated to us, from Hisham, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah, from 'Urwah, from Asma', from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: "There is nothing possessing more protective jealousy (ghayrah) than Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2763 a, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَزِيدَ، بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَصَابَ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ قُبْلَةً فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ - قَالَ - فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ طَرَفَىِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذَلِكَ ذِكْرَى لِلذَّاكِرِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ أَلِيَ هَذِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِمَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Abu Kamil Fudayl ibn Husayn al-Jahdari both narrated to us from Yazid ibn Zuray'—and the wording is Abu Kamil's: Yazid narrated to us: Al-Taymi narrated to us, from Abu 'Uthman, from 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, that a man took a kiss from a woman, so he came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and mentioned that to him. He said: Thereupon was revealed: {And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember}. He said: The man asked: "Is this for me, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "For whoever acts upon it from my ummah."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2763 b, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ، مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ أَصَابَ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ إِمَّا قُبْلَةً أَوْ مَسًّا بِيَدٍ أَوْ شَيْئًا كَأَنَّهُ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ كَفَّارَتِهَا - قَالَ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us: Al-Mu'tamir narrated to us, from his father: Abu 'Uthman narrated to us, from Ibn Mas'ud, that a man came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and mentioned that he had taken from a woman either a kiss, or a touch with the hand, or something [similar], as though he were asking about its expiation. He said: So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed [the verse]. Then he mentioned the like of the hadith of Yazid.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2763 c, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ أَصَابَ رَجُلٌ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ شَيْئًا دُونَ الْفَاحِشَةِ فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَعَظَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَتَى أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَعَظَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ وَالْمُعْتَمِرِ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Jarir narrated to us, from Sulayman al-Taymi, with this chain of transmission, saying: A man took from a woman something short of immoral conduct (intercourse), so he came to 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, who regarded it as grave upon him. Then he came to Abu Bakr, who regarded it as grave upon him. Then he came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he mentioned the like of the hadith of Yazid and al-Mu'tamir.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2763 d, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي عَالَجْتُ امْرَأَةً فِي أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَإِنِّي أَصَبْتُ مِنْهَا مَا دُونَ أَنْ أَمَسَّهَا فَأَنَا هَذَا فَاقْضِ فِيَّ مَا شِئْتَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ لَقَدْ سَتَرَكَ اللَّهُ لَوْ سَتَرْتَ نَفْسَكَ - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فَقَامَ الرَّجُلُ فَانْطَلَقَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً دَعَاهُ وَتَلاَ عَلَيْهِ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ [quran sura="11" aya_start="114" aya_end="114"]‏{‏ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ طَرَفَىِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذَلِكَ ذِكْرَى لِلذَّاكِرِينَ‏}‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ هَذَا لَهُ خَاصَّةً قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلْ لِلنَّاسِ كَافَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah—and the wording is Yahya's—narrated to us; Yahya said: Abu al-Ahwas informed us, and the other two said: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Simak, from Ibrahim, from 'Alqamah and al-Aswad, from 'Abdullah, who said: A man came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I approached a woman intimately at the furthest edge of Medina, and I took from her what fell short of having intercourse with her. Here I am, so pass whatever judgment you wish concerning me." 'Umar said to him: "Allah had concealed your fault if only you had concealed yourself." He said: The Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) did not reply anything, so the man stood up and walked away. Then the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) sent a man after him who called him back, and he recited this verse to him: {And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember}. A man from among the people asked: "O Prophet of Allah, is this specifically for him?" He said: "Rather, for all people."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2763 e, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْعِجْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ خَالِهِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا لِهَذَا خَاصَّةً أَوْ لَنَا عَامَّةً قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلْ لَكُمْ عَامَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Abu al-Nu'man al-Hakam ibn 'Abdullah al-'Ijli narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, who said: I heard Ibrahim narrating from his maternal uncle al-Aswad, from 'Abdullah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) with the meaning of the hadith of Abu al-Ahwas, and he said in his hadith: Mu'adh said: "O Messenger of Allah, is this specifically for this man, or for us in general?" He said: "Rather, for you in general."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2764, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ - قَالَ - وَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْ فِيَّ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ حَضَرْتَ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ غُفِرَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Hulwani narrated to us: 'Amr ibn 'Asim narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us, from Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas, who said: A man came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed an offense incurring a prescribed penalty, so execute it upon me." He said: And the prayer arrived, so he prayed with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). When he concluded the prayer, he said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed an offense incurring a prescribed penalty, so execute the Book of Allah upon me." He said: "Did you attend the prayer with us?" He said: "Yes." He said: "You have been forgiven."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2765, book 50, باب قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَدَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَنَحْنُ قُعُودٌ مَعَهُ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَعَادَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ فَاتَّبَعَ الرَّجُلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ انْصَرَفَ وَاتَّبَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْظُرُ مَا يَرُدُّ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فَلَحِقَ الرَّجُلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ - قَالَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ - فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَ حِينَ خَرَجْتَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ تَوَضَّأْتَ فَأَحْسَنْتَ الْوُضُوءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ شَهِدْتَ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ غَفَرَ لَكَ حَدَّكَ - أَوْ قَالَ - ذَنْبَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Nasr ibn 'Ali al-Jahdami and Zuhayr ibn Harb—and the wording is Zuhayr's—narrated to us: 'Umar ibn Yunus narrated to us: 'Ikrimah ibn 'Ammar narrated to us: Shaddad narrated to us: Abu Umamah narrated to us, who said: While the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was in the mosque and we were sitting with him, a man came and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed an offense incurring a prescribed penalty (hadd), so execute it upon me." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) remained silent toward him. Then he repeated, saying: "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed an offense incurring a prescribed penalty, so execute it upon me." He remained silent toward him, and the prayer was established. When the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) finished [the prayer], Abu Umamah said: The man followed the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) when he left, and I followed the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) to see what he would reply to the man. The man caught up with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed an offense incurring a prescribed penalty, so execute it upon me." Abu Umamah said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: "Did you not, when you left your house, perform ablution and do it well?" He said: "Yes indeed, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Then you attended the prayer with us?" He said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to him: "Then indeed Allah has forgiven you your prescribed penalty"—or he said—"your sin."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2766 a, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ كَانَ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ رَجُلٌ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا فَسَأَلَ عَنْ أَعْلَمِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ فَدُلَّ عَلَى رَاهِبٍ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنَ تَوْبَةٍ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَتَلَهُ فَكَمَّلَ بِهِ مِائَةً ثُمَّ سَأَلَ عَنْ أَعْلَمِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ فَدُلَّ عَلَى رَجُلٍ عَالِمٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَتَلَ مِائَةَ نَفْسٍ فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ وَمَنْ يَحُولُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ التَّوْبَةِ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى أَرْضِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَإِنَّ بِهَا أُنَاسًا يَعْبُدُونَ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مَعَهُمْ وَلاَ تَرْجِعْ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ فَإِنَّهَا أَرْضُ سَوْءٍ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى إِذَا نَصَفَ الطَّرِيقَ أَتَاهُ الْمَوْتُ فَاخْتَصَمَتْ فِيهِ مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ فَقَالَتْ مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ جَاءَ تَائِبًا مُقْبِلاً بِقَلْبِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ مَلاَئِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُمْ مَلَكٌ فِي صُورَةِ آدَمِيٍّ فَجَعَلُوهُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ قِيسُوا مَا بَيْنَ الأَرْضَيْنِ فَإِلَى أَيَّتِهِمَا كَانَ أَدْنَى فَهُوَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَاسُوهُ فَوَجَدُوهُ أَدْنَى إِلَى الأَرْضِ الَّتِي أَرَادَ فَقَبَضَتْهُ مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا أَتَاهُ الْمَوْتُ نَأَى بِصَدْرِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Muhammad ibn Bashshar—and the wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's—narrated to us: Mu'adh ibn Hisham narrated to us: My father narrated to me, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Siddiq, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Among those who were before you, there was a man who killed ninety-nine persons. Then he asked about the most knowledgeable of the inhabitants of the earth, and he was directed to a monk. He came to him and said that he had killed ninety-nine persons, so was there any repentance for him? He said: 'No.' So he killed him, completing one hundred with him. Then he asked about the most knowledgeable of the inhabitants of the earth, and he was directed to a scholar. He said that he had killed one hundred persons, so was there any repentance for him? He said: 'Yes, and who can stand between him and repentance? Go to such and such a land, for in it are people who worship Allah, so worship Allah with them, and do not return to your land, for it is an evil land.' So he set out until, when he reached the halfway point of the road, death came to him. The angels of mercy and the angels of punishment disputed over him. The angels of mercy said: 'He came repentant, turning with his heart to Allah.' And the angels of punishment said: 'He never did any good at all.' Then an angel came to them in the form of a human being, so they appointed him [as an arbitrator] between them. He said: 'Measure the distance between the two lands; whichever of the two he is closer to, he belongs to it.' So they measured it and found him closer to the land that he intended, so the angels of mercy took his soul." Qatadah said: Al-Hasan said: It was mentioned to us that when death came to him, he leaned forward with his chest.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2766 b, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيَّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا فَجَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ هَلْ لَهُ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ فَأَتَى رَاهِبًا فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ لَيْسَتْ لَكَ تَوْبَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَتَلَ الرَّاهِبَ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ فِيهَا قَوْمٌ صَالِحُونَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ أَدْرَكَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَنَأَى بِصَدْرِهِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَاخْتَصَمَتْ فِيهِ مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ فَكَانَ إِلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الصَّالِحَةِ أَقْرَبَ مِنْهَا بِشِبْرٍ فَجُعِلَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari narrated to me: My father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah, that he heard Aba al-Siddiq al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): "A man killed ninety-nine persons, so he began asking whether there was any repentance for him. He came to a monk and asked him, and he said: 'There is no repentance for you.' So he killed the monk. Then he began asking, and then he departed from one village to a village in which there were righteous people. When he was partway along the journey, death overtook him, so he leaned forward with his chest, then died. Thereupon, the angels of mercy and the angels of punishment disputed over him. He was closer to the righteous village by a handspan, so he was counted among its people."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2766 c, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ وَزَادَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَبَاعَدِي وَإِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَقَرَّبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Ibn Abi 'Adi narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah, with this chain of transmission similar to the hadith of Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh, and he added to it: "So Allah inspired to this [land]: 'Become distant,' and to that [land]: 'Draw near.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2767 a, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي، بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ دَفَعَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ إِلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيًّا فَيَقُولُ هَذَا فَكَاكُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Talhah ibn Yahya, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "When the Day of Resurrection comes, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will hand over to every Muslim a Jew or a Christian, and He will say: 'This is your ransom from the Fire.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2767 b, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ عَوْنًا، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، شَهِدَا أَبَا بُرْدَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَمُوتُ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ إِلاَّ أَدْخَلَ اللَّهُ مَكَانَهُ النَّارَ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَحْلَفَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَحَلَفَ لَهُ - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْنِي سَعِيدٌ أَنَّهُ اسْتَحْلَفَهُ وَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ عَلَى عَوْنٍ قَوْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Affan ibn Muslim narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us that 'Awn and Sa'id ibn Abi Burdah narrated to him that they both witnessed Abu Burdah narrating to 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz from his father, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "No Muslim man dies except that Allah admits in his place a Jew or a Christian into the Fire." He said: So 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz adjured him by Allah, besides Whom there is no deity, three times that his father narrated it to him from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he swore to him. He said: And Sa'id did not narrate to me that he adjured him, nor did he contest 'Awn's statement.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2767 c, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الْوَارِثِ أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَفَّانَ وَقَالَ عَوْنُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna both narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Samad ibn 'Abd al-Warith: Hammam informed us: Qatadah narrated to us with this chain of transmission similar to the hadith of 'Affan, and he said: "'Awn ibn 'Utbah."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2767 d, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَدَّادٌ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ الرَّاسِبِيُّ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَجِيءُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِذُنُوبٍ أَمْثَالِ الْجِبَالِ فَيَغْفِرُهَا اللَّهُ لَهُمْ وَيَضَعُهَا عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِيمَا أَحْسِبُ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو رَوْحٍ لاَ أَدْرِي مِمَّنِ الشَّكُّ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالَ أَبُوكَ حَدَّثَكَ هَذَا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Amr ibn 'Abbad ibn Jabalah ibn Abi Rawwad narrated to us: Harami ibn 'Umarah narrated to us: Shaddad Abu Talhah al-Rasibi narrated to us, from Ghaylan ibn Jarir, from Abu Burdah, from his father, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "On the Day of Resurrection, people from among the Muslims will come with sins like mountains, and Allah will forgive them for them and place them upon the Jews and the Christians"—as far as I think. Abu Rawh said: I do not know from whom the doubt was. Abu Burdah said: So I narrated it to 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz, and he said: "Did your father narrate this to you from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)?" I said: "Yes."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2768, book 50, باب قَبُولِ تَوْبَةِ الْقَاتِلِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ قَتْلُهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ كَيْفَ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي النَّجْوَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يُدْنَى الْمُؤْمِنُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَتَّى يَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ كَنَفَهُ فَيُقَرِّرُهُ بِذُنُوبِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ تَعْرِفُ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ أَعْرِفُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي قَدْ سَتَرْتُهَا عَلَيْكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَإِنِّي أَغْفِرُهَا لَكَ الْيَوْمَ ‏.‏ فَيُعْطَى صَحِيفَةَ حَسَنَاتِهِ وَأَمَّا الْكُفَّارُ وَالْمُنَافِقُونَ فَيُنَادَى بِهِمْ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلاَئِقِ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Qatadah, from Safwan ibn Muhriz, who said: A man said to Ibn 'Umar: How did you hear the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) speaking about the private confidential discourse (al-najwa)? He said: I heard him saying: "The believer will be brought near to his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, on the Day of Resurrection until He places His veil over him and makes him confess his sins, saying: 'Do you recognize [this]?' He will say: 'O my Lord, I recognize [it].' He will say: 'Indeed, I concealed them for you in the world, and indeed I forgive them for you today.' Then he will be given the record of his good deeds. As for the disbelievers and the hypocrites, they will be called out before the heads of all creation: 'These are the ones who lied against Allah.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2769 a, b, book 50, باب حَدِيثِ تَوْبَةِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ وَصَاحِبَيْهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ مَوْلَى بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ ثُمَّ غَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ تَبُوكَ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ الرُّومَ وَنَصَارَى الْعَرَبِ بِالشَّامِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ كَانَ قَائِدَ كَعْبٍ مِنْ بَنِيهِ حِينَ عَمِيَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثَهُ حِينَ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ قَالَ كَعْبُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ لَمْ أَتَخَلَّفْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةٍ غَزَاهَا قَطُّ إِلاَّ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ غَيْرَ أَنِّي قَدْ تَخَلَّفْتُ فِي غَزْوَةِ بَدْرٍ وَلَمْ يُعَاتِبْ أَحَدًا تَخَلَّفَ عَنْهُ إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ يُرِيدُونَ عِيرَ قُرَيْشٍ حَتَّى جَمَعَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ عَدُوِّهُمْ عَلَى غَيْرِ مِيعَادٍ وَلَقَدْ شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ حِينَ تَوَاثَقْنَا عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي بِهَا مَشْهَدَ بَدْرٍ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ بَدْرٌ أَذْكَرَ فِي النَّاسِ مِنْهَا وَكَانَ مِنْ خَبَرِي حِينَ تَخَلَّفْتُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ أَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ قَطُّ أَقْوَى وَلاَ أَيْسَرَ مِنِّي حِينَ تَخَلَّفْتُ عَنْهُ فِي تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةِ وَاللَّهِ مَا جَمَعْتُ قَبْلَهَا رَاحِلَتَيْنِ قَطُّ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُهُمَا فِي تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةِ فَغَزَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَرٍّ شَدِيدٍ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ سَفَرًا بَعِيدًا وَمَفَازًا وَاسْتَقْبَلَ عَدُوًّا كَثِيرًا فَجَلاَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ أَمْرَهُمْ لِيَتَأَهَّبُوا أُهْبَةَ غَزْوِهِمْ فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ بِوَجْهِهِمُ الَّذِي يُرِيدُ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَثِيرٌ وَلاَ يَجْمَعُهُمْ كِتَابُ حَافِظٍ - يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ الدِّيوَانَ - قَالَ كَعْبٌ فَقَلَّ رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَغَيَّبَ يَظُنُّ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ سَيَخْفَى لَهُ مَا لَمْ يَنْزِلْ فِيهِ وَحْىٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَغَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةَ حِينَ طَابَتِ الثِّمَارُ وَالظِّلاَلُ فَأَنَا إِلَيْهَا أَصْعَرُ فَتَجَهَّزَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مَعَهُ وَطَفِقْتُ أَغْدُو لِكَىْ أَتَجَهَّزَ مَعَهُمْ فَأَرْجِعُ وَلَمْ أَقْضِ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ وَأَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَا قَادِرٌ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِذَا أَرَدْتُ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ يَتَمَادَى بِي حَتَّى اسْتَمَرَّ بِالنَّاسِ الْجِدُّ فَأَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَادِيًا وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مَعَهُ وَلَمْ أَقْضِ مِنْ جَهَازِي شَيْئًا ثُمَّ غَدَوْتُ فَرَجَعْتُ وَلَمْ أَقْضِ شَيْئًا فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ يَتَمَادَى بِي حَتَّى أَسْرَعُوا وَتَفَارَطَ الْغَزْوُ فَهَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَرْتَحِلَ فَأُدْرِكَهُمْ فَيَا لَيْتَنِي فَعَلْتُ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُقَدَّرْ ذَلِكَ لِي فَطَفِقْتُ إِذَا خَرَجْتُ فِي النَّاسِ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْزُنُنِي أَنِّي لاَ أَرَى لِي أُسْوَةً إِلاَّ رَجُلاً مَغْمُوصًا عَلَيْهِ فِي النِّفَاقِ أَوْ رَجُلاً مِمَّنْ عَذَرَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الضُّعَفَاءِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى بَلَغَ تَبُوكًا فَقَالَ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فِي الْقَوْمِ بِتَبُوكَ ‏"‏ مَا فَعَلَ كَعْبُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَلِمَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَبَسَهُ بُرْدَاهُ وَالنَّظَرُ فِي عِطْفَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ خَيْرًا ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ رَأَى رَجُلاً مُبَيِّضًا يَزُولُ بِهِ السَّرَابُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كُنْ أَبَا خَيْثَمَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا هُو أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ وَهُوَ الَّذِي تَصَدَّقَ بِصَاعِ التَّمْرِ حِينَ لَمَزَهُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَعْبُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ تَوَجَّهَ قَافِلاً مِنْ تَبُوكَ حَضَرَنِي بَثِّي فَطَفِقْتُ أَتَذَكَّرُ الْكَذِبَ وَأَقُولُ بِمَ أَخْرُجُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ غَدًا وَأَسْتَعِينُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ كُلَّ ذِي رَأْىٍ مِنْ أَهْلِي فَلَمَّا قِيلَ لِي إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَظَلَّ قَادِمًا زَاحَ عَنِّي الْبَاطِلُ حَتَّى عَرَفْتُ أَنِّي لَنْ أَنْجُوَ مِنْهُ بِشَىْءٍ أَبَدًا فَأَجْمَعْتُ صِدْقَهُ وَصَبَّحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَادِمًا وَكَانَ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ بَدَأَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَرَكَعَ فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ لِلنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ جَاءَهُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ فَطَفِقُوا يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ وَكَانُوا بِضْعَةً وَثَمَانِينَ رَجُلاً فَقَبِلَ مِنْهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلاَنِيَتَهُمْ وَبَايَعَهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُمْ وَوَكَلَ سَرَائِرَهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ حَتَّى جِئْتُ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمْتُ تَبَسَّمَ تَبَسُّمَ الْمُغْضَبِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَالَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ أَمْشِي حَتَّى جَلَسْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ مَا خَلَّفَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَلَمْ تَكُنْ قَدِ ابْتَعْتَ ظَهْرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَوْ جَلَسْتُ عِنْدَ غَيْرِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا لَرَأَيْتُ أَنِّي سَأَخْرُجُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ بِعُذْرٍ وَلَقَدْ أُعْطِيتُ جَدَلاً وَلَكِنِّي
