text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الزَّرْعِ لاَ تَزَالُ الرِّيحُ تُمِيلُهُ وَلاَ يَزَالُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يُصِيبُهُ الْبَلاَءُ وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَمَثَلِ شَجَرَةِ الأَرْزِ لاَ تَهْتَزُّ حَتَّى تَسْتَحْصِدَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from az-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The likeness of the believer is like that of crops: the wind continues to bend it, and afflictions continue to strike the believer; and the likeness of the hypocrite is like that of the cedar tree: it does not shake until it is cut down completely."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2809 b, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَالزَّرْعِ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَشَجَرِ الأَرْزِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ مَكَانَ قَوْلِهِ تُمِيلُهُ ‏"‏ تُفِيئُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us from 'Abd ar-Razzaq: Ma'mar narrated to us, from az-Zuhri with this chain of narration, except that in the hadith of 'Abd ar-Razzaq, in place of his words "bends it", it has "blows it over".

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2810 a, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَالزَّرْعِ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَشَجَرِ الأَرْزِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، كَعْبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفِيئُهَا الرِّيحُ وَتَصْرَعُهَا مَرَّةً وَتَعْدِلُهَا أُخْرَى حَتَّى تَهِيجَ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الأَرْزَةِ الْمُجْذِيَةِ عَلَى أَصْلِهَا لاَ يُفِيئُهَا شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Abdullah ibn Numayr and Muhammad ibn Bishr both narrated to us: Zakariyya ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim: The son of Ka'b ibn Malik narrated to me, from his father, Ka'b, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The likeness of the believer is like the tender shoot of crops, which the wind bends, knocking it down at times and straightening it at other times, until it withers; and the likeness of the disbeliever is like the cedar tree standing firm on its root, which nothing bends, until it is uprooted all at once."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2810 b, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَالزَّرْعِ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَشَجَرِ الأَرْزِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفِيئُهَا الرِّيَاحُ تَصْرَعُهَا مَرَّةً وَتَعْدِلُهَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ أَجَلُهُ وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ مَثَلُ الأَرْزَةِ الْمُجْذِيَةِ الَّتِي لاَ يُصِيبُهَا شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Bishr ibn as-Sari and 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Mahdi both narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The likeness of the believer is like the tender plant of crops, which the winds bend, knocking it down at times and straightening it at other times, until his appointed time comes to him; and the likeness of the hypocrite is like the firmly rooted cedar tree which is affected by nothing until it is uprooted all at once."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2810 c, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَالزَّرْعِ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَشَجَرِ الأَرْزِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَمَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَحْمُودًا قَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ بِشْرٍ ‏"‏ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الأَرْزَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Hatim and Mahmud ibn Ghaylan both narrated it to me, saying: Bishr ibn as-Sari narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from 'Abdullah ibn Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, except that Mahmud said in his narration from Bishr: "and the likeness of the disbeliever is like the cedar tree," whereas Ibn Hatim said: "the likeness of the hypocrite," just as Zuhayr said.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2810 d, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَالزَّرْعِ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَشَجَرِ الأَرْزِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَقَالاَ جَمِيعًا فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى، ‏"‏ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ مَثَلُ الأَرْزَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar and 'Abdullah ibn Hashim both narrated it to us, saying: Yahya—meaning al-Qattan—narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim—Ibn Hashim said: from 'Abdullah ibn Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father, while Ibn Bashshar said: from the son of Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father—from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, with the like of their hadith, and they both said in their hadith from Yahya: "and the likeness of the disbeliever is like the cedar tree."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2811 a, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ النَّخْلَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ شَجَرَةً لاَ يَسْقُطُ وَرَقُهَا وَإِنَّهَا مَثَلُ الْمُسْلِمِ فَحَدِّثُونِي مَا هِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَوَقَعَ النَّاسُ فِي شَجَرِ الْبَوَادِي ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ ثُمَّ قَالُوا حَدِّثْنَا مَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ قَالَ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, and 'Ali ibn Hujr as-Sa'di narrated to us—and the wording is Yahya's—they said: Isma'il—meaning Ibn Ja'far—narrated to us: 'Abdullah ibn Dinar reported to me that he heard 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, among trees there is a tree whose leaves do not fall, and it is the likeness of the Muslim; so tell me what it is." The people's thoughts turned to the trees of the desert. 'Abdullah said: It occurred to my mind that it was the date-palm, but I was shy. Then they said: "Tell us what it is, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "It is the date-palm." He said: So I mentioned that to 'Umar, and he said: "That you had said 'it is the date-palm' would have been more beloved to me than such-and-such."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2811 b, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ النَّخْلَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ، الضُّبَعِيِّ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُونِي عَنْ شَجَرَةٍ مَثَلُهَا مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلَ الْقَوْمُ يَذْكُرُونَ شَجَرًا مِنْ شَجَرِ الْبَوَادِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَأُلْقِيَ فِي نَفْسِي أَوْ رُوعِيَ أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ فَجَعَلْتُ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَقُولَهَا فَإِذَا أَسْنَانُ الْقَوْمِ فَأَهَابُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ فَلَمَّا سَكَتُوا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Ubayd al-Ghubari narrated to me: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us: Ayyub narrated to us, from Abu al-Khalil ad-Duba'i, from Mujahid, from Ibn 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said one day to his companions: "Tell me about a tree whose likeness is like the likeness of the believer." The people began mentioning trees of the desert. Ibn 'Umar said: It was cast into my mind—or it occurred to my heart—that it was the date-palm, so I wanted to say it, but then I noticed the elders of the people, so I felt too in awe to speak. When they remained silent, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "It is the date-palm."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2811 c, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ النَّخْلَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ حَدِيثًا وَاحِدًا قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأُتِيَ بِجُمَّارٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ibn Abi 'Umar both narrated to us: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: I accompanied Ibn 'Umar to Madinah and did not hear him narrate from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, except a single hadith. He said: We were with the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, when palm pith was brought to him... and he mentioned similar to their hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2811 d, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ النَّخْلَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ، عُمَرَ يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجُمَّارٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Numayr narrated to us: My father narrated to us: Sayf narrated to us, saying: I heard Mujahid say: I heard Ibn 'Umar say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, was brought palm pith... and he mentioned the like of their hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2811 e, book 52, باب مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ النَّخْلَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُونِي بِشَجَرَةٍ شِبْهِ أَوْ كَالرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَتَحَاتُّ وَرَقُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَعَلَّ مُسْلِمًا قَالَ وَتُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا ‏.‏ وَكَذَا وَجَدْتُ عِنْدَ غَيْرِي أَيْضًا وَلاَ تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ وَرَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ لاَ يَتَكَلَّمَانِ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ أَوْ أَقُولَ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us: 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Umar narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said: We were with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and he said: "Tell me of a tree that is like—or resembles—the Muslim man: its leaves do not fall..." Ibrahim said: perhaps Muslim said: "and it yields its fruit." And thus I found it with other than me as well: "and it yields its fruit all the time." Ibn 'Umar said: It occurred to me that it is the date-palm, but I saw that Abu Bakr and 'Umar were not speaking, so I disliked speaking or saying anything. 'Umar said: "That you had said it would have been more beloved to me than such-and-such."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2812 a, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ أَيِسَ أَنْ يَعْبُدَهُ الْمُصَلُّونَ فِي جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَلَكِنْ فِي التَّحْرِيشِ بَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us—Ishaq said: reported to us, while 'Uthman said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "Indeed, Satan has despaired of being worshipped by the worshipers in the Arabian Peninsula, but [he seeks] to incite discord between them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2812 b, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us: Waki' narrated to us; (and a different chain) Abu Kurayb narrated to us: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, both from al-A'mash with this chain of narration.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2813 a, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ عَرْشَ إِبْلِيسَ عَلَى الْبَحْرِ فَيَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ فَيَفْتِنُونَ النَّاسَ فَأَعْظَمُهُمْ عِنْدَهُ أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us—Ishaq said: reported to us, while 'Uthman said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "Indeed, the throne of Iblis is upon the sea, and he sends out his raiding parties to tempt people, and the greatest of them in his sight is the one who causes the greatest tribulation."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2813 b, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ يَضَعُ عَرْشَهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ فَأَدْنَاهُمْ مِنْهُ مَنْزِلَةً أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ فَعَلْتُ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَيَقُولُ مَا صَنَعْتَ شَيْئًا قَالَ ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ مَا تَرَكْتُهُ حَتَّى فَرَّقْتُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ امْرَأَتِهِ - قَالَ - فَيُدْنِيهِ مِنْهُ وَيَقُولُ نِعْمَ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَيَلْتَزِمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kurayb Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us—and the wording is Abu Kurayb's—they said: Abu Mu'awiyah reported to us: Al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, Iblis places his throne upon the water, then he sends out his detachments; the closest of them to him in status is the one greatest in causing tribulation. One of them comes and says: 'I did such-and-such,' so he says: 'You have done nothing.' He said: Then one of them comes and says: 'I did not leave him until I separated him from his wife.' He said: So he draws him close to himself and says: 'How excellent you are!'" Al-A'mash said: I believe he said: "and he embraces him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2813 c, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَبْعَثُ الشَّيْطَانُ سَرَايَاهُ فَيَفْتِنُونَ النَّاسَ فَأَعْظَمُهُمْ عِنْدَهُ مَنْزِلَةً أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me: Al-Hasan ibn A'yan narrated to us: Ma'qil narrated to us, from Abu az-Zubayr, from Jabir, that he heard the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "Satan dispatches his raiding parties so that they tempt people into tribulation, and the one of them greatest in status with him is the one who causes the greatest tribulation."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2814 a, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ وُكِّلَ بِهِ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَإِيَّاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِيَّاىَ إِلاَّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ فَأَسْلَمَ فَلاَ يَأْمُرُنِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us—Ishaq said: reported to us, while 'Uthman said: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from his father, from 'Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "There is no one among you except that there has been assigned over him his companion from among the jinn." They said: "And you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "And me, except that Allah has helped me against him, so he has submitted, and he does not command me except with good."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2814 b, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِيَانِ ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ رُزَيْقٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏"‏ وَقَدْ وُكِّلَ بِهِ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَقَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar both narrated to us: 'Abd ar-Rahman—meaning Ibn Mahdi—narrated to us, from Sufyan; (and a different chain) Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Yahya ibn Adam narrated to us, from 'Ammar ibn Ruzayq, both from Mansur with the chain of Jarir, the like of his hadith, except that in the hadith of Sufyan: "and there has been appointed over him his companion from among the jinn and his companion from among the angels."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2815, book 52, بَاب تَحْرِيشِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبَعْثِهِ سَرَايَاهُ لِفِتْنَةِ النَّاسِ وَأَنَّ مَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَرِينًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، قُسَيْطٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا لَيْلاً ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَغِرْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَجَاءَ فَرَأَى مَا أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ يَا عَائِشَةُ أَغِرْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا لِي لاَ يَغَارُ مِثْلِي عَلَى مِثْلِكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَقَدْ جَاءَكِ شَيْطَانُكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوَمَعِيَ شَيْطَانٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَعَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَلَكِنْ رَبِّي أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى أَسْلَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Abu Sakhr reported to me, from Ibn Qusayt, that 'Urwah narrated to him that 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, narrated to him that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, left her place at night. She said: I felt jealous about him. Then he came and saw what I was doing, so he said: "What is the matter with you, O 'A'ishah? Have you become jealous?" I said: "How could someone like me not feel jealous over someone like you?" The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Has your devil come to you?" She said: "O Messenger of Allah, is there a devil with me?" He said: "Yes." I said: "And with every human being?" He said: "Yes." I said: "And with you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Yes, but my Lord helped me against him until he submitted."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 a, b, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَنْ يُنْجِيَ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ وَلاَ إِيَّاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ إِيَّاىَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ وَلَكِنْ سَدِّدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّدَفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو، بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ وَلَكِنْ سَدِّدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us, from Bukayr, from Busr ibn Sa'id, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, that he said: "The deeds of none of you will ever save him." A man said: "Not even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah encompasses me with mercy from Him; but follow the right course." And Yunus ibn 'Abd al-A'la as-Sadafi narrated it to me: 'Abdullah ibn Wahb reported to us: 'Amr ibn al-Harith reported to me, from Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj with this chain of narration, except that he said: "with mercy from Him and grace," and did not mention: "but follow the right course."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 c, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُدْخِلُهُ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي رَبِّي بِرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Hammad—meaning Ibn Zayd—narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "There is no one whose deeds will admit him into Paradise." It was said: "Not even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Not even me, unless my Lord encompasses me with mercy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 d, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ يُنْجِيهِ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا وَأَشَارَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Ibn Abi 'Adi narrated to us, from Ibn 'Awn, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "There is no one among you whose deeds will save him." They said: "Not even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah encompasses me with forgiveness from Him and mercy." And Ibn 'Awn gestured with his hand like this, pointing over his head: "Not even me, unless Allah encompasses me with forgiveness from Him and mercy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 e, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُنْجِيهِ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَدَارَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Jarir narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "There is no one whose deeds will save him." They said: "Not even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah reaches me with mercy from Him."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 f, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبَّادٍ، يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِفَضْلٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me: Abu 'Abbad Yahya ibn 'Abbad narrated to us: Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us: Ibn Shihab narrated to us, from Abu 'Ubayd, the freed slave of 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn 'Awf, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The deeds of none of you will ever admit him into Paradise." They said: "Not even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah encompasses me with grace from Him and mercy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 g, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَارِبُوا وَسَدِّدُوا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَنْجُوَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ بِعَمَلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us: My father narrated to us: Al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Seek moderation, follow the right course, and know that none among you will be saved by his deeds." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, not even you?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah encompasses me with mercy from Him and grace."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2816 h, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ وَأَبْشِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb both narrated to us: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, the like of it, and he added: "and receive glad tidings."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2817 a, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Numayr narrated to us: My father narrated to us: Al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2817 b, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا كَرِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash with both chains of narration, like the narration of Ibn Numayr.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2817 c, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يُدْخِلُ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَلاَ يُجِيرُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me: Al-Hasan ibn A'yan narrated to us: Ma'qil narrated to us, from Abu az-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "The deeds of none among you will admit him into Paradise, nor will they save him from the Fire—nor me, except by mercy from Allah."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2818 a, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ، عُقْبَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، بْنُ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا فَإِنَّهُ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ أَحَدًا عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَحَبَّ الْعَمَلِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهُ وَإِنْ قَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Muhammad reported to us: Musa ibn 'Uqbah reported to us; (and a different chain) Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me—and the wording is his: Bahz narrated to us: Wuheyb narrated to us: Musa ibn 'Uqbah narrated to us, saying: I heard Abu Salamah ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn 'Awf narrate from 'A'ishah, the wife of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, that she used to say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Follow the right course, seek moderation, and receive glad tidings, for no one's deeds will ever admit him into Paradise." They said: "Not even you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah encompasses me with mercy from Him. And know that the most beloved of deeds to Allah is that which is most consistent, even if it is small."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2818 b, book 52, باب لَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَحَدٌ الْجَنَّةَ بِعَمَلِهِ بَلْ بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنُ الْمُطَّلِبِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ وَأَبْشِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Hasan al-Hulwani narrated it to us: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us: 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn al-Muttalib narrated to us, from Musa ibn 'Uqbah with this chain of narration, and he did not mention: "and receive glad tidings."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2819 a, book 52, باب إِكْثَارِ الأَعْمَالِ وَالاِجْتِهَادِ فِي الْعِبَادَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ، شُعْبَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى حَتَّى انْتَفَخَتْ قَدَمَاهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَتَكَلَّفُ هَذَا وَقَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Ziyad ibn 'Ilaqah, from al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, prayed until his feet became swollen, so it was said to him: "Do you burden yourself with this when Allah has already forgiven you what preceded of your sin and what came after?" He said: "Should I not be a grateful servant?"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2819 b, book 52, باب إِكْثَارِ الأَعْمَالِ وَالاِجْتِهَادِ فِي الْعِبَادَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، سَمِعَ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى وَرِمَتْ قَدَمَاهُ قَالُوا قَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ibn Numayr both narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ziyad ibn 'Ilaqah, who heard al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah say: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, stood in prayer until his feet swelled. They said: "Allah has already forgiven you what preceded of your sin and what came after." He said: "Should I not be a grateful servant?"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2820, book 52, باب إِكْثَارِ الأَعْمَالِ وَالاِجْتِهَادِ فِي الْعِبَادَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى قَامَ حَتَّى تَفَطَّرَ رِجْلاَهُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَصْنَعُ هَذَا وَقَدْ غُفِرَ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn Ma'ruf and Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli both narrated to us: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Abu Sakhr reported to me, from Ibn Qusayt, from 'Urwah ibn az-Zubayr, from 'A'ishah, who said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, prayed, he would stand until his feet cracked. 'A'ishah said: "O Messenger of Allah, do you do this when Allah has already forgiven you what preceded of your sin and what came after?" He said: "O 'A'ishah, should I not be a grateful servant?"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2821 a, book 52, باب الاِقْتِصَادِ فِي الْمَوْعِظَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ بَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ نَنْتَظِرُهُ فَمَرَّ بِنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ النَّخَعِيُّ فَقُلْنَا أَعْلِمْهُ بِمَكَانِنَا ‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُخْبَرُ بِمَكَانِكُمْ فَمَا يَمْنَعُنِي أَنْ أَخْرُجَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِلاَّ كَرَاهِيَةُ أَنْ أُمِلَّكُمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَخَوَّلُنَا بِالْمَوْعِظَةِ فِي الأَيَّامِ مَخَافَةَ السَّآمَةِ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Waki' and Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us; (and a different chain) Ibn Numayr narrated to us—and the wording is his: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq, who said: We were sitting at the door of 'Abdullah waiting for him, when Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah an-Nakha'i passed by us, so we said: "Inform him of our presence." He entered upon him, and it was not long before 'Abdullah came out to us and said: "I was informed of your presence, but nothing prevents me from coming out to you except that I dislike causing you boredom. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, used to space out the days when admonishing us, out of fear that weariness might overtake us."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2821 b, book 52, باب الاِقْتِصَادِ فِي الْمَوْعِظَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، بْنُ يُونُسَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ مِنْجَابٌ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to us: Ibn Idris narrated to us; (and a different chain) Minjab ibn al-Harith at-Tamimi narrated to us: Ibn Mushir narrated to us; (and a different chain) Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and 'Ali ibn Khashram both narrated to us: 'Isa ibn Yunus reported to us; (and a different chain) Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, all of them from al-A'mash with this chain of narration, similar to it. Minjab added in his narration from Ibn Mushir: Al-A'mash said: And 'Amr ibn Murrah narrated to me from Shaqiq, from 'Abdullah, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2821 c, book 52, باب الاِقْتِصَادِ فِي الْمَوْعِظَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُذَكِّرُنَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ خَمِيسٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّا نُحِبُّ حَدِيثَكَ وَنَشْتَهِيهِ وَلَوَدِدْنَا أَنَّكَ حَدَّثْتَنَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا يَمْنَعُنِي أَنْ أُحَدِّثَكُمْ إِلاَّ كَرَاهِيَةُ أَنْ أُمِلَّكُمْ ‏.‏ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَخَوَّلُنَا بِالْمَوْعِظَةِ فِي الأَيَّامِ كَرَاهِيَةَ السَّآمَةِ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Jarir reported to us, from Mansur; (and a different chain) Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us—and the wording is his: Fudayl ibn 'Iyad narrated to us, from Mansur, from Shaqiq Abu Wa'il, who said: 'Abdullah used to remind us every Thursday, so a man said to him: "O Abu 'Abd ar-Rahman, we love your discourse and yearn for it, and we would love for you to speak to us every day." He said: "Nothing prevents me from speaking to you except that I dislike causing you boredom. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, used to space out the days when admonishing us, out of fear that weariness might overtake us."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2822, book 53, باب ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حُفَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ وَحُفَّتِ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abdullah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us: Hammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thabit and Humayd, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and the Fire is surrounded by desires."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2823, book 53, باب ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Shababah narrated to us: Warqa' narrated to me, from Abu az-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2824 a, book 53, باب ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، سَعِيدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مِصْدَاقُ ذَلِكَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ ‏[quran sura="32" aya_start="17" aya_end="17"]{‏ فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏
en_text: Sa'id ibn 'Amr al-Ash'athi and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us—Zuhayr said: narrated to us, while Sa'id said: Sufyan reported to us, from Abu az-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never crossed the mind of any human being.'" The confirmation of that is in the Book of Allah: {"And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for the eyes as a reward for what they used to do"}.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2824 b, book 53, باب ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ذُخْرًا بَلْهَ مَا أَطْلَعَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Malik narrated to us, from Abu az-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never crossed the mind of any human being—as a treasured store, not to mention that which Allah has disclosed to you.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2824 c, book 53, باب ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏.‏ ذُخْرًا بَلْهَ مَا أَطْلَعَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏[quran sura="32" aya_start="17" aya_end="17"]{‏ فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ‏}‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, saying: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us; (and a different chain) Ibn Numayr narrated to us—and the wording is his: My father narrated to us: Al-A'mash narrated to us, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never crossed the mind of any human being'—as a treasured store, not to mention that which Allah has disclosed to you." Then he recited: {"And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for the eyes"}.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2825, book 53, باب ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، يَقُولُ شَهِدْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَجْلِسًا وَصَفَ فِيهِ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى ثُمَّ قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي آخِرِ حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ فِيهَا مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اقْتَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏[quran sura="32" aya_start="16" aya_end="17"]{‏ تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ * فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn Ma'ruf and Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli both narrated to us: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Abu Sakhr narrated to me that Abu Hazim narrated to him, saying: I heard Sahl ibn Sa'd as-Sa'idi say: I attended a gathering with the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, in which he described Paradise until he concluded, then he, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said at the end of his hadith: "In it is that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never crossed the mind of any human being." Then he recited this verse: {"Their sides part from their beds, calling upon their Lord in fear and hope, and they spend of what We have provided them. And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for the eyes as a reward for what they used to do"}.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2826 a, book 53, باب إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, that he said: "Indeed, in Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels for a hundred years."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2826 b, book 53, باب إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Al-Mughirah—meaning Ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman al-Hizami—narrated to us, from Abu az-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, the like of it, and he added: "without traversing it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2827, 2828, book 53, باب إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَبِي، حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ الزُّرَقِيَّ، فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ الْجَوَادَ الْمُضَمَّرَ السَّرِيعَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ مَا يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanthali narrated to us: Al-Makhzumi reported to us: Wuheyb narrated to us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd, from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "Indeed, in Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider travels for a hundred years without traversing it." Abu Hazim said: I narrated it to an-Nu'man ibn Abi 'Ayyash az-Zuraqi, and he said: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri narrated to me from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "Indeed, in Paradise there is a tree in whose shade a rider of a well-trained, swift thoroughbred horse travels for a hundred years without traversing it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2829, book 53, باب إِحْلاَلِ الرِّضْوَانِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَلاَ يَسْخَطُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبَدًا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ، بْنُ أَنَسٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ لَبَّيْكَ رَبَّنَا وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ رَضِيتُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ وَمَا لَنَا لاَ نَرْضَى يَا رَبِّ وَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَيَقُولُ أَلاَ أُعْطِيكُمْ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُونَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ أُحِلُّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِضْوَانِي فَلاَ أَسْخَطُ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Sahm narrated to us: 'Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak narrated to us: Malik ibn Anas reported to us; (and a different chain) Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me—and the wording is his: 'Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us: Malik ibn Anas narrated to me, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from 'Ata' ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, Allah will say to the people of Paradise: 'O people of Paradise!' They will say: 'Here we are, our Lord, at Your service, and all good is in Your hands.' He will say: 'Are you well-pleased?' They will say: 'Why should we not be well-pleased, O Lord, when You have given us what You have not given to anyone else among Your creation?' He will say: 'Shall I not give you something better than that?' They will say: 'O Lord, what thing could be better than that?' He will say: 'I bestow My pleasure upon you, so I will never be angry with you after it, ever.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2830, 2831 a, book 53, باب تَرَائِي أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ كَمَا يُرَى الْكَوْكَبُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا تَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِذَلِكَ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كَمَا تَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ فِي الأُفُقِ الشَّرْقِيِّ أَوِ الْغَرْبِيِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Ya'qub—meaning Ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman al-Qari—narrated to us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, the people of Paradise will look up at the chambers in Paradise just as you look at the stars in the sky." He said: I narrated that to an-Nu'man ibn Abi 'Ayyash, and he said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri say: "just as you look at a brilliant star on the eastern or western horizon."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2830 b, book 53, باب تَرَائِي أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ كَمَا يُرَى الْكَوْكَبُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يَعْقُوبَ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us: Al-Makhzumi reported to us: Wuheyb narrated to us, from Abu Hazim with both chains of narration, similar to the hadith of Ya'qub.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2831 b, book 53, باب تَرَائِي أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ كَمَا يُرَى الْكَوْكَبُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ كَمَا تَتَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ الْغَابِرَ مِنَ الأُفُقِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ أَوِ الْمَغْرِبِ لِتَفَاضُلِ مَا بَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تِلْكَ مَنَازِلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ لاَ يَبْلُغُهَا غَيْرُهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ رِجَالٌ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَصَدَّقُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far ibn Yahya ibn Khalid narrated to me: Ma'n narrated to us: Malik narrated to us; (and a different chain) Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me—and the wording is his: 'Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us: Malik ibn Anas reported to me, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from 'Ata' ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, the people of Paradise will look up at the occupants of the high chambers above them just as you look at a brilliant distant star on the horizon from the east or the west, because of the superiority that exists between them." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, are those the dwellings of the prophets, which no one else can reach?" He said: "Yes, by the One in Whose hand is my soul! They are people who believed in Allah and affirmed the truth of the messengers."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2832, book 53, باب فِيمَنْ يَوَدُّ رُؤْيَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ أَشَدِّ أُمَّتِي لِي حُبًّا نَاسٌ يَكُونُونَ بَعْدِي يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ رَآنِي بِأَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Ya'qub—meaning Ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman—narrated to us, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Among those of my nation who love me most intensely will be people coming after me, each of whom would wish he could see me even at the cost of his family and his wealth."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2833, book 53, باب فِي سُوقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا يَنَالُونَ فِيهَا مِنَ النَّعِيمِ وَالْجَمَالِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ الْبَصْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، الْبُنَانِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَسُوقًا يَأْتُونَهَا كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ فَتَهُبُّ رِيحُ الشَّمَالِ فَتَحْثُو فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ وَثِيَابِهِمْ فَيَزْدَادُونَ حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً فَيَرْجِعُونَ إِلَى أَهْلِيهِمْ وَقَدِ ازْدَادُوا حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُوهُمْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدِ ازْدَدْتُمْ بَعْدَنَا حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ وَأَنْتُمْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدِ ازْدَدْتُمْ بَعْدَنَا حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu 'Uthman Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar al-Basri narrated to us: Hammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thabit al-Bunani, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, in Paradise there is a marketplace to which they will come every Friday. Then a north wind will blow and scatter fragrance upon their faces and their garments, and they will increase in beauty and grace. They will return to their families having increased in beauty and grace, and their families will say to them: 'By Allah, you have increased in beauty and grace after us!' And they will say: 'And you, by Allah, have increased in beauty and grace after us!'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2834 a, book 53, بَاب أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَصِفَاتُهُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَعْقُوبَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ إِمَّا تَفَاخَرُوا وَإِمَّا تَذَاكَرُوا الرِّجَالُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَكْثَرُ أَمِ النِّسَاءُ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَوَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا عَلَى أَضْوَإِ كَوْكَبٍ دُرِّيٍّ فِي السَّمَاءِ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ اثْنَتَانِ يُرَى مُخُّ سُوقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ وَمَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَعْزَبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr an-Naqid and Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ad-Dawraqi both narrated to me from Ibn 'Ulayyah—and the wording is Ya'qub's—they said: Isma'il ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us: Ayyub reported to us, from Muhammad, who said: Whether they were boasting or discussing whether men or women will be more numerous in Paradise, Abu Hurayrah said: Did not Abu al-Qasim, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "Indeed, the first group to enter Paradise will be in the likeness of the moon on the night of the full moon, and the one that follows it will be like the brightest radiant star in the sky; each man among them will have two wives, the marrow of whose shins will be seen through the flesh, and there will be no bachelor in Paradise"?

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2834 b, book 53, بَاب أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَصِفَاتُهُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ اخْتَصَمَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ أَيُّهُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَكْثَرُ فَسَأَلُوا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, who said: Men and women disputed as to which of them would be more numerous in Paradise, so they asked Abu Hurayrah, and he said: Abu al-Qasim, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said—the like of the hadith of Ibn 'Ulayyah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2834 c, book 53, بَاب أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَصِفَاتُهُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ، الْقَعْقَاعِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَالَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ عَلَى أَشَدِّ كَوْكَبٍ دُرِّيٍّ فِي السَّمَاءِ إِضَاءَةً لاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَتْفُلُونَ أَمْشَاطُهُمُ الذَّهَبُ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ وَمَجَامِرُهُمُ الأَلُوَّةُ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمُ الْحُورُ الْعِينُ أَخْلاَقُهُمْ عَلَى خُلُقِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى صُورَةِ أَبِيهِمْ آدَمَ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: 'Abd al-Wahid—meaning Ibn Ziyad—narrated to us, from 'Umarah ibn al-Qa'qa': Abu Zur'ah narrated to us, saying: I heard Abu Hurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The first to enter Paradise..."; (and a different chain) Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us—and the wording is Qutaybah's—they said: Jarir narrated to us, from 'Umarah, from Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Indeed, the first group to enter Paradise will be in the likeness of the moon on the night of the full moon, and those who follow them will be like the brightest radiant star in the sky. They will not urinate, nor defecate, nor blow their noses, nor spit. Their combs will be gold, their sweat musk, their incense burners aloeswood, and their spouses the wide-eyed houris. Their disposition will be upon the character of a single man, in the form of their father Adam: sixty cubits tall into the sky."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2834 d, book 53, بَاب أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَصِفَاتُهُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ عَلَى أَشَدِّ نَجْمٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ إِضَاءَةً ثُمَّ هُمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مَنَازِلُ لاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَبْزُقُونَ أَمْشَاطُهُمُ الذَّهَبُ وَمَجَامِرُهُمُ الأَلُوَّةُ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ أَخْلاَقُهُمْ عَلَى خُلُقِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى طُولِ أَبِيهِمْ آدَمَ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ عَلَى خُلُقِ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ عَلَى خَلْقِ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ أَبِيهِمْ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us, saying: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The first group from my nation to enter Paradise will be in the likeness of the moon on the night of the full moon, then those who follow them will be like the brightest shining star in the sky, then after that they will have different ranks. They will not defecate, nor urinate, nor blow their noses, nor spit. Their combs will be gold, their incense burners aloeswood, and their sweat musk. Their disposition will be upon the character of a single man, on the height of their father Adam: sixty cubits." Ibn Abi Shaybah said: "upon the character of a man," while Abu Kurayb said: "upon the physical stature of a man." And Ibn Abi Shaybah said: "upon the form of their father."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2834 e, book 53, باب فِي صِفَاتِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِهَا وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَلِجُ الْجَنَّةَ صُوَرُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ لاَ يَبْصُقُونَ فِيهَا وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ فِيهَا آنِيَتُهُمْ وَأَمْشَاطُهُمْ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَمَجَامِرُهُمْ مِنَ الأَلُوَّةِ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ يُرَى مُخُّ سَاقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ مِنَ الْحُسْنِ لاَ اخْتِلاَفَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلاَ تَبَاغُضَ قُلُوبُهُمْ قَلْبٌ وَاحِدٌ يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّهَ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to us: 'Abd ar-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma'mar narrated to us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurayrah narrated to us from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him—and he mentioned hadiths, among which: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The first group to enter Paradise will have their forms like the form of the moon on the night of the full moon. They will not spit therein, nor blow their noses, nor defecate therein. Their vessels and combs will be of gold and silver, their incense burners of aloeswood, and their sweat musk. Each one of them will have two wives, the marrow of whose shins can be seen through the flesh because of their beauty. There will be no discord among them, nor any mutual hatred; their hearts will be as one single heart, glorifying Allah morning and evening."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2835 a, book 53, باب فِي صِفَاتِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِهَا وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ يَأْكُلُونَ فِيهَا وَيَشْرَبُونَ وَلاَ يَتْفُلُونَ وَلاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَا بَالُ الطَّعَامِ قَالَ ‏"‏ جُشَاءٌ وَرَشْحٌ كَرَشْحِ الْمِسْكِ يُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالتَّحْمِيدَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us—and the wording is 'Uthman's; 'Uthman said: narrated to us, while Ishaq said: Jarir reported to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say: "Indeed, the people of Paradise eat and drink therein, but they do not spit, nor urinate, nor defecate, nor blow their noses." They asked: "Then what happens to the food?" He said: "A burp and a sweat like the fragrance of musk; they are inspired with glorification and praise just as they are inspired with breathing."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2835 b, book 53, باب فِي صِفَاتِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِهَا وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ كَرَشْحِ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb both narrated to us: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash with this chain of narration up to his words: "like the fragrance of musk."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2835 c, book 53, باب فِي صِفَاتِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِهَا وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ، - قَالَ حَسَنٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَأْكُلُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ فِيهَا وَيَشْرَبُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلَكِنْ طَعَامُهُمْ ذَاكَ جُشَاءٌ كَرَشْحِ الْمِسْكِ يُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالْحَمْدَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَجَّاجٍ ‏"‏ طَعَامُهُمْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Hulwani and Hajjaj ibn ash-Sha'ir both narrated to me from Abu 'Asim—Hasan said: Abu 'Asim narrated to us—from Ibn Jurayj: Abu az-Zubayr reported to me that he heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "The people of Paradise will eat and drink therein, but they will neither defecate, nor blow their noses, nor urinate; rather, their food will be [expelled through] a burp like the fragrance of musk. They will be inspired with glorification and praise just as they are inspired with breathing." He said: And in the hadith of Hajjaj: "that food of theirs."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2835 d, book 53, باب فِي صِفَاتِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِهَا وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالتَّكْبِيرَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi narrated to me: My father narrated to me: Ibn Jurayj narrated to us: Abu az-Zubayr reported to me, from Jabir, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, similar to it, except that he said: "and they will be inspired with glorification and magnification just as they are inspired with breathing."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2836, book 53, بَاب فِي دَوَامِ نَعِيمِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَقَوْله تَعَالَى وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمْ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ يَنْعَمُ لاَ يَبْأَسُ لاَ تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُ وَلاَ يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us: Hammad ibn Salamah narrated to us, from Thabit, from Abu Rafi', from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "Whoever enters Paradise will enjoy bliss and never experience misery; his garments will never wear out, and his youth will never perish."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2837, book 53, بَاب فِي دَوَامِ نَعِيمِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَقَوْله تَعَالَى وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمْ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ قَالَ الثَّوْرِيُّ فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، أَنَّ الأَغَرَّ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يُنَادِي مُنَادٍ إِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَصِحُّوا فَلاَ تَسْقَمُوا أَبَدًا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَحْيَوْا فَلاَ تَمُوتُوا أَبَدًا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَشِبُّوا فَلاَ تَهْرَمُوا أَبَدًا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَنْعَمُوا فَلاَ تَبْتَئِسُوا أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏[quran sura="7" aya_start="43" aya_end="43"]{‏ وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us—and the wording is Ishaq's—they said: 'Abd ar-Razzaq reported to us, saying: Ath-Thawri said: Abu Ishaq narrated to me that al-Agharr narrated to him from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "A caller will call out: 'Indeed, it is for you to be healthy and never fall ill, ever; and it is for you to live and never die, ever; and it is for you to be youthful and never grow old, ever; and it is for you to enjoy bliss and never experience misery, ever.' That is His words, Mighty and Majestic: {'And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made to inherit because of what you used to do"'}."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2838 a, book 53, باب فِي صِفَةِ خِيَامِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِيهَا مِنَ الأَهْلِينَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قُدَامَةَ، - وَهُوَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَبِي، عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَخَيْمَةً مِنْ لُؤْلُؤَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مُجَوَّفَةٍ طُولُهَا سِتُّونَ مِيلاً لِلْمُؤْمِنِ فِيهَا أَهْلُونَ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ فَلاَ يَرَى بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us, from Abu Qudamah—namely al-Harith ibn 'Ubayd—from Abu 'Imran al-Jawni, from Abu Bakr ibn 'Abdullah ibn Qays, from his father, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "Indeed, the believer in Paradise has a tent made of a single hollowed pearl, its length being sixty miles; the believer has wives in it whom he visits in turn, and none of them sees the others."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2838 b, book 53, باب فِي صِفَةِ خِيَامِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِيهَا مِنَ الأَهْلِينَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْمَةٌ مِنْ لُؤْلُؤَةٍ مُجَوَّفَةٍ عَرْضُهَا سِتُّونَ مِيلاً فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ مَا يَرَوْنَ الآخَرِينَ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Ghassan al-Misma'i narrated to me: Abu 'Abd as-Samad narrated to us: Abu 'Imran al-Jawni narrated to us, from Abu Bakr ibn 'Abdullah ibn Qays, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "In Paradise there is a tent of a single hollowed pearl, its width being sixty miles; in each corner of it are wives whom the others do not see, and the believer visits them in turn."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2838 c, book 53, باب فِي صِفَةِ خِيَامِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِيهَا مِنَ الأَهْلِينَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي، عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْخَيْمَةُ دُرَّةٌ طُولُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ سِتُّونَ مِيلاً فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ لاَ يَرَاهُمُ الآخَرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us: Hammam reported to us, from Abu 'Imran al-Jawni, from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Musa ibn Qays, from his father, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "The tent is a pearl whose height into the sky is sixty miles; in each corner of it the believer has a family whom the others do not see."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2839, book 53, باب مَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مِنْ أَنْهَارِ الْجَنَّةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَيْحَانُ وَجَيْحَانُ وَالْفُرَاتُ وَالنِّيلُ كُلٌّ مِنْ أَنْهَارِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Abu Usamah, 'Abdullah ibn Numayr, and 'Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Umar; (and a different chain) Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Bishr narrated to us: 'Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Khubayb ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman, from Hafs ibn 'Asim, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Sayhan, Jayhan, the Euphrates, and the Nile are all among the rivers of Paradise."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2840, book 53, باب يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ أَقْوَامٌ أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِثْلُ أَفْئِدَةِ الطَّيْرِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ اللَّيْثِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ أَقْوَامٌ أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِثْلُ أَفْئِدَةِ الطَّيْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn ash-Sha'ir narrated to us: Abu an-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim al-Laythi narrated to us: Ibrahim—meaning Ibn Sa'd—narrated to us: My father narrated to us, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said: "There will enter Paradise people whose hearts are like the hearts of birds."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2841, book 53, باب يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ أَقْوَامٌ أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِثْلُ أَفْئِدَةِ الطَّيْرِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ آدَمَ عَلَى صُورَتِهِ طُولُهُ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا فَلَمَّا خَلَقَهُ قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَسَلِّمْ عَلَى أُولَئِكَ النَّفَرِ وَهُمْ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ جُلُوسٌ فَاسْتَمِعْ مَا يُجِيبُونَكَ فَإِنَّهَا تَحِيَّتُكَ وَتَحِيَّةُ ذُرِّيَّتِكَ قَالَ فَذَهَبَ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَقَالُوا السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَزَادُوهُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَكُلُّ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ آدَمَ وَطُولُهُ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا فَلَمْ يَزَلِ الْخَلْقُ يَنْقُصُ بَعْدَهُ حَتَّى الآنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to us: 'Abd ar-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma'mar reported to us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, who said: This is what Abu Hurayrah narrated to us from the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him—and he mentioned hadiths, among which: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: "Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created Adam in His image, his height being sixty cubits. When He created him, He said: 'Go and greet those individuals—a group of angels who were sitting—and listen to how they answer you, for it will be your greeting and the greeting of your offspring.' He said: So he went and said: 'As-Salamu 'alaykum (Peace be upon you).' They said: 'As-Salamu 'alayka wa Rahmatullah (Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah).' He said: So they added: 'and the mercy of Allah.' He said: So everyone who enters Paradise will be in the form of Adam and his height sixty cubits. Creation has continued to diminish after him until now."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2842, book 53, باب فِي شِدَّةِ حَرِّ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ وَبُعْدِ قَعْرِهَا وَمَا تَأْخُذُ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْكَاهِلِيِّ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُؤْتَى بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَهَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ زِمَامٍ مَعَ كُلِّ زِمَامٍ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ يَجُرُّونَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
